home.h2: Free online games for kids and the whole family
home.intro:
Pixuvo is a free games portal for kids aged about 6 to 15 and their families. There are more than 45,000 browser games here, from puzzles and racing to dress-up and sports. You don't need an account, you don't sign up and you don't download anything: pick a game, press play and it starts right in the web page. Pixuvo doesn't make the games itself; they come from partner publishers, and new ones are added every day.

Finding something to play is easy. Browse by category, open the 2 player section when a friend or sibling sits next to you, or check the new games and the popular lists, which are based on what people really play. Save any game you like to your favorites. Favorites and recently played games are saved in this browser on this device, so there's no login to remember. Many games also work on phones and tablets – each game page shows it.

Parents can find a separate page that explains how Pixuvo handles safety, including that games with violent, adult or gambling wording are held for manual review before they appear. Not sure where to start? Puzzle fans can try Drop Planets or Merge Royal, young learners like Kobadoo Numbers, racers can jump into Moto X3M: Spooky Land, and dress-up fans enjoy Aidol K-pop Adventure.

2-player.intro:
Grab a friend, a sibling or a parent, and sit down at the same keyboard. 2 player games are made for exactly that – two people, one game, and lots of laughing. Pixuvo has more than 1,400 of them.

In most 2 player games, both players share one computer. One person usually controls a character with WASD, and the other with the arrow keys. Some games are competitive duels and races, where you try to beat each other; Red Hands - 2 Player Game, Gun and Guys, Geometri Tag Wars - 2 Players and Racing Ball 3D are listed near the top. Others are cooperative, where you work together as a team. Adventures of Two Kittens II, Cute Sheep Skyblock and Lava Ladder Leap are more games to try together. Calm thinking games like Tic Tac Toe Pro - Multiplayer & Challenge are great for younger kids, and Kids: Cute Pairs is another gentle pick. A few 2 player games also have online modes.

Before you start, decide who gets which keys – the game's start screen usually shows the controls. Co-op games are a great choice when one player is younger, because you win together. Shared keyboard games work best on a computer; plenty of them work on phones and tablets as well – the game page says so.

faq.q: How do you play 2 player games on one keyboard?
faq.a: Usually one player uses the WASD keys and the other the arrow keys. The controls are shown on the game's start screen or in its description.

faq.q: What are good 2 player games for kids?
faq.a: Tic Tac Toe Pro is calm and simple, and Kids: Cute Pairs, Adventures of Two Kittens II, Red Hands - 2 Player Game and Racing Ball 3D are also good first picks.

faq.q: Are there 2 player games where you work together?
faq.a: Yes, co-op games let you solve levels as a team instead of playing against each other. They are perfect when one player is younger or new to games – the game description says whether a game is co-op.

faq.q: Can I play 2 player games online with a friend?
faq.a: Some 2 player games have online modes, but most are made for two people on the same device. The game page says which when the publisher provides it.

faq.q: Are there 2 player card or board games?
faq.a: Yes, games like Tic Tac Toe Pro are easy two-player picks, and our board, chess and card sections have many more games you can play in turns.

2048.intro:
Two plus two makes four, four plus four makes eight… and if you keep merging long enough, you reach 2048. That is the whole idea of this famous number puzzle, and it is much harder than it sounds. Pixuvo has more than 200 free 2048 games, from the classic grid to 3D cubes and merge races.

In the original game, numbered tiles sit on a 4×4 grid. Each time you slide in one direction, every tile moves, and two tiles with the same number merge into one with double the value. After every move a new small tile appears, so the board slowly fills up. If you want the classic version, 2048 Classic Puzzle - Challenge is a good one to start with. Other games take the merging idea in new directions, from 3D cubes to races and .io arenas – Chain Cube 2048 3D, Snake 2048.io, Jelly Run in 2048, Merge Grabber Race to 2048 and Merge Royal are a few to try.

The best-known strategy is to pick one corner and keep your biggest tile there. Slide mostly in two directions and only use the third when you must, so big numbers stay in a neat line. 2048 is also a sneaky way to practice doubling numbers. Use the arrow keys on a computer or swipe on a touch screen – many games also work on phones and tablets, and the game page shows it.

faq.q: How do you play 2048?
faq.a: Slide all tiles up, down, left or right. Two tiles with the same number merge into one with double the value, and the goal is to create a 2048 tile before the board fills up.

faq.q: What is the best strategy for 2048?
faq.a: Keep your largest tile in one corner and build a chain of decreasing numbers next to it. Avoid swiping in the direction that pulls the big tile out of its corner.

faq.q: Is 2048 good for learning math?
faq.a: It practices doubling and powers of two (2, 4, 8, 16 and so on) in a playful way, and it trains planning ahead.

faq.q: Are there 3D versions of 2048?
faq.a: Yes, the category also has 3D takes on the merging idea. Chain Cube 2048 3D and Merge Cubes are two to try.

faq.q: Can I play 2048 on my phone?
faq.a: 2048 is played with simple swipes, so many versions work on phones and tablets. Check the game page to see if mobile is supported.

action.intro:
Your heart beats a little faster, the screen fills with enemies and you have about half a second to decide what to do. That rush is why kids keep coming back to action games. Pixuvo has more than 6,500 of them, from silly stickman battles to arena brawls, and every one runs right in your browser with no download and no account.

Action is a big family, so it helps to know the branches. Fighting games put you in one-on-one duels and arena scraps, while ninja games swap brute force for sneaking, jumping across rooftops and throwing shuriken. Outside those two, you will find tower defense mixes, survival waves and physics battles where the funniest move often wins. Good first picks listed near the top are Stickman Warriors, Sumo Shove and Knockback Knights.

New to the genre? Start with a game that has short rounds, so a loss only costs you a minute. Most action games on a computer use the arrow keys or WASD to move and the space bar or mouse to attack, and the game page usually lists the controls. Many of them also run on phones and tablets – each game page tells you if it does. Some fighting games include cartoon violence, so parents can check our parents page for how we review games.

faq.q: What are action games?
faq.a: Action games are built around fast reflexes and quick decisions: dodging, jumping, fighting and reacting to what happens on screen. Most have short rounds, so they are easy to pick up and hard to put down.

faq.q: What are good action games for beginners?
faq.a: Pick games with short rounds and simple controls, so you learn the moves fast and a lost round only costs you a minute. To get going, try Sumo Shove and Stickman Warriors.

faq.q: Can two players play action games on one computer?
faq.a: Many can. In a lot of 2 player action games one player uses WASD and the other uses the arrow keys on the same keyboard; the game page says when a game is for two players.

faq.q: Are action games too violent for kids?
faq.a: Most browser action games use cartoon or stickman-style fighting rather than realistic violence. Games with violent wording are held for manual review, and our parents page explains how we check games.

faq.q: Do I need to download anything to play?
faq.a: No. Every action game on Pixuvo runs in your web browser – just click and play, with no sign-up.

adventure.intro:
Every good adventure starts with a question: what is behind that door, over that hill or at the end of this story? Adventure games let you find out. Pixuvo has more than 8,500 free adventure games where you explore new places, solve problems and keep going until the journey is complete.

Adventure is one of the widest genres on the site. Some games are about exploring and crafting, others mix in action and fights, and some let you roam freely across a big map. Idle adventures keep progressing even when you only play a few minutes at a time. Right now Dungeon Master - Cult & Craft, Samurai Brawling, Horse Simulator 3D and Merge Mine - Idle Clicker sit near the top of the list. And if you love tricky rooms and hidden clues, the escape games subcategory is full of locked doors waiting for you to work out the way out.

How do you choose? Think about what you enjoy most. If you like stories, look for games with levels or chapters. If you like freedom, pick an open map you can wander. If you have only a short break, an idle or merge adventure fits best. Most use the mouse or arrow keys, and the game page explains the controls. Lots of these games work on a phone or tablet too; check the game page to be sure. Your favorites are saved in this browser, so you can come back to a long adventure later.

faq.q: What are adventure games?
faq.a: Adventure games are about exploring, solving problems and following a goal or story through many places or levels. They are usually less about speed and more about curiosity.

faq.q: How do you play adventure games?
faq.a: Explore everything, talk to characters or click on objects, and collect items that might help later. If you get stuck, go back to places you have already visited – the answer is often there.

faq.q: What are good adventure games for kids?
faq.a: Not sure where to begin? Pick Horse Simulator 3D or Dungeon Master - Cult & Craft. For a puzzle twist, try the escape games subcategory.

faq.q: Can I save my progress in adventure games?
faq.a: Many games keep their own progress in your browser, and Pixuvo saves your favorites and recently played games on this device. Use the same browser to pick up where you left off.

faq.q: Are adventure games free on Pixuvo?
faq.a: Yes, every adventure game on Pixuvo is free to play in your browser, with no account or download.

arcade.intro:
Insert coin, press start, beat the high score – that simple loop has kept people playing since arcade machines appeared in the early 1970s. Today you do not need a pocket full of quarters. Pixuvo has more than 12,000 free arcade games you can start in one click in your browser.

What makes a game feel "arcade"? Short rounds, easy controls, rising difficulty and a score that makes you want one more try. Inside this huge category you will find runner games where you keep moving and dodge obstacles, retro games inspired by the pixel era, snake games where you grow longer with every snack, and bubble shooter games where you aim and match colors. There are also quick party games for two friends, such as 12 MiniBattles - Two Players.

To find your favorite type, try a few different ones for a couple of minutes each – Epic Duck, Buba Jump, Popcorn Race 3D and Gelatino are listed near the top. Most arcade games need only one or two keys, the mouse or a tap, so they are perfect for a short break. Playing on a tablet? Many games support it, and the game page shows which ones. Popular lists on Pixuvo are based on real plays, so they are a good shortcut to what other kids enjoy right now.

faq.q: What are arcade games?
faq.a: Arcade games are quick, easy-to-learn games built around score, timing and getting better each try. The name comes from coin-operated machines in game arcades.

faq.q: When did arcade games come out?
faq.a: Coin-operated video arcade games became popular in the early 1970s, and the golden age of arcades followed in the late 1970s and early 1980s. Many browser games today still use the same pick-up-and-play idea.

faq.q: What are some arcade games I can play for free?
faq.a: Try Epic Duck, Buba Jump or Popcorn Race 3D on Pixuvo – they run in the browser for free. The runner, retro, snake and bubble shooter subcategories have thousands more.

faq.q: Are there 2 player arcade games?
faq.a: Yes. Many arcade-style games are made for two players – 12 MiniBattles - Two Players is one to try – and the game page shows when a game supports two players.

faq.q: Can I play arcade games on a phone or tablet?
faq.a: Many arcade games use simple taps, so they often work on phones and tablets. Check the game page to see if mobile is supported.

archery.intro:
Pull back the string, check the wind, and let go. Archery is one of the oldest sports in the world, and on screen it is all about one satisfying moment: the arrow flying in an arc and hitting exactly where you aimed. Pixuvo has more than 140 archery games, from calm target practice to silly stickman duels.

Most of them fall into a few groups. Target and challenge games ask you to hit bullseyes, apples or moving objects while the distance and wind keep changing. Duel games put two archers on opposite sides, and the better shot wins – Two Archers Bow Duel is one to try. Then there are puzzle-style archery games, where finding the right path matters more than fast hands, and adventure-style games where your bow keeps creatures away. Archer vs Monsters, Archery Quest, Archer 2023, Arrow Clash and Tricky Arrow are more games to try.

New to the bow? Start with a target game to learn how high to aim for far shots, then try a duel against a friend or the computer. On a computer you usually aim with the mouse; on phones and tablets you drag and release with a finger, which feels a lot like pulling a real bowstring. The game page shows whether a game works on touch screens.

faq.q: How do you aim in archery games?
faq.a: In most games you click or touch, drag backward to pull the string, and let go to shoot. The longer you pull, the stronger the shot, and for far targets you aim a little higher because the arrow drops as it flies.

faq.q: Can two players play archery games together?
faq.a: Yes, some archery games are made for two players, such as duel games where two archers face each other. Check the game page to see whether a game is for one or two players.

faq.q: Why does my arrow miss when I aim straight at the target?
faq.a: Many archery games add gravity and wind, so the arrow curves on its way. Watch the wind arrow or number on the screen and aim slightly against it.

faq.q: Are archery games good for younger kids?
faq.a: Target and puzzle archery games are simple to learn and focus on aiming rather than fighting. Parents can read the game description first or visit our parents page for more tips.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. Every game on Pixuvo is free, with no account and nothing to download – it opens right in your web browser.

basketball.intro:
Swish! There is something special about the sound of a perfect shot, and basketball games let you chase that feeling again and again. Pixuvo has more than 300 of them, and most are easy to learn: aim, choose the power, release.

Shooting games are a big group: you flick or aim the ball toward the hoop and try to score from different spots. Dunk and trick-shot games turn it into a physics puzzle, where you bounce, drop or sling the ball into the basket, and runner games add moving and dodging. Perfect Shot, Basket Sniper, Chill Dunk and Drop Dunks are good first picks, while Sling Dunk, BasketBall Runner, Basketball Beans and Incredible Basketball are more to try.

A good way to start is a calm shooting game, because it teaches the arc of the shot – usually a high, soft throw goes in more often than a flat, hard one. After that, dunk puzzles are a nice challenge for thinkers. Basketball games work great with a mouse, and since many use a simple swipe or drag, they are also fun on phones and tablets; check the game page to see if a game supports mobile.

faq.q: How long are basketball games?
faq.a: A real NBA game has four quarters of 12 minutes, and school games are usually shorter. Browser basketball games are quick – a round often takes just a minute or two, so they are perfect for short breaks.

faq.q: How do you shoot in online basketball games?
faq.a: Usually you drag or swipe from the ball toward the hoop and let go. A higher arc tends to drop in more often, and many games show a helper line while you are learning.

faq.q: What are dunk games?
faq.a: Dunk games are often basketball puzzles where you have to get the ball into the hoop with bounces, drops or slingshots instead of a normal shot. Drop Dunks and Sling Dunk are two to try.

faq.q: Are there basketball games for two players?
faq.a: Some basketball games have a two-player mode on one keyboard, and the game page says when a game supports it. Look in our 2 player section for more games to play with a friend.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. Every basketball game on Pixuvo is free to play in the browser, with no sign-up.

block.intro:
Drop the piece, fill the row, clear the line – and make room for the next one. Block puzzles are some of the most satisfying games around, because every cleared row feels like tidying up. Pixuvo offers more than 1,100 free block puzzle games for your browser.

Block puzzles come in a few main styles. In grid puzzles, you drag shapes onto a board and clear full rows and columns, and many grid puzzles have no timer pushing you. In falling-block games, pieces drop from the top and you rotate them into place before they land. Then there are sliding puzzles, where you move blocks out of the way to free one piece, and color puzzles, where you line up matching pieces. 10x10! Block Puzzle Classic, Wood Block Puzzle - Block Game, Block Crush Challenge, TenTrix, Block Buster, Unlock Block - Puzzle and Color Lines are all listed near the top.

If you are just starting, pick a grid puzzle without a timer so you can think about each move. A smart habit is to keep space open for the long and awkward shapes, because those are the ones that end your game. Falling-block games are faster and great for practicing quick decisions. Most block puzzles need only a mouse or a tap, and lots of these games work on a phone or tablet too; check the game page to be sure. Explore more brain teasers in the puzzle category.

faq.q: How do you play block puzzle games?
faq.a: You place blocks of different shapes on a grid and clear lines by filling complete rows or columns. The game ends when no more pieces fit.

faq.q: What is the best strategy for block puzzles?
faq.a: Keep the board as open as possible and leave room for large or long pieces. Clearing several lines at once often gives bonus points.

faq.q: Are there falling-block games here?
faq.a: Yes. Falling-block games follow the classic idea of rotating pieces as they drop and clearing full lines. Grid puzzles are calmer because pieces do not fall.

faq.q: Which block puzzle is good for beginners?
faq.a: A grid puzzle without a timer is a calm start, because you can think at your own pace. Wood Block Puzzle - Block Game and 10x10! Block Puzzle Classic are good ones to start with.

faq.q: Can I play block puzzles on my phone?
faq.a: Block puzzles are played by dragging or tapping, so many work well on phones and tablets. The game page shows if mobile is supported.

board.intro:
Family game night does not need a cupboard full of boxes. Board games on Pixuvo bring classic tabletop games to the screen, and there are more than 700 of them, from quick tic-tac-toe rounds to long, thoughtful chess matches.

Chess has its own section, with lots of versions. Battleship games like TRZ Battleship and Intergalactic Battleship are about guessing where the enemy ships are hidden. Tic Tac Toe Multiplayer X O is the classic three-in-a-row game that everyone knows. BattleBox, Unno Game, Shape Defense and Mahjong Street Cafe are more games listed near the top, and tile games like mahjong belong here too.

Board games are perfect for playing together. Many can be played by two people on the same device, taking turns, and some have online modes too – the game page says which. Playing against the computer is a great way to learn the rules before challenging a friend or a parent. Board games are turn-based, so there is no rush, and they usually need only clicks or taps. That makes them comfortable on computers, tablets and many phones – you can see on the game page whether a phone or tablet will work.

faq.q: What board games can I play online here?
faq.a: You will find chess, battleship, tic-tac-toe and many other tabletop ideas brought to the screen. Chess has its own section with lots of versions.

faq.q: Can two people play board games on one device?
faq.a: Yes, many board games let two players take turns on the same computer or tablet. Some also offer online play; the game page shows which modes a game has.

faq.q: How do you play battleship?
faq.a: Each player hides ships on a grid and then takes turns guessing squares to hit the other player's ships. The first to sink the whole enemy fleet wins.

faq.q: Are board games good for kids?
faq.a: Board games teach turn-taking, planning and following rules, and they are great for playing together as a family. Starting against the computer is an easy way to learn.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. All board games on Pixuvo are free to play in the browser, with no account.

bubble-shooter.intro:
Aim, shoot, match three of the same color – and watch the whole cluster pop. Bubble shooter games are one of the most relaxing ways to play, yet a single clever shot that drops half the board feels amazing. Pixuvo offers more than 750 free bubble shooter games in your browser.

The rules are simple. Bubbles hang at the top of the screen, and you fire one bubble at a time from the bottom. When three or more of the same color touch, they burst, and any bubbles hanging below them fall too. Bubble Shooter and Bubble Shooter POP are easy places to start. Other games add new themes and twists to the same idea – try Space Bubbles Must Die!, Bobble Space Shooter, Pixel Bubble Shooter or Ball Burst.

Two tricks help a lot. First, bounce shots off the side walls to reach bubbles you cannot hit directly. Second, aim for bubbles that hold up big groups, because dropping a cluster scores more than popping a few at a time. Bubble shooters need only a mouse or a finger, so they are easy for younger kids and comfortable on touch screens, and lots of these games work on a phone or tablet too; check the game page to be sure. Bubble shooters are part of the arcade category.

faq.q: How do you play bubble shooter?
faq.a: Aim and shoot colored bubbles at the group at the top. When three or more of the same color touch, they pop, and anything hanging below them falls.

faq.q: What is the trick to winning bubble shooter?
faq.a: Use wall bounces to reach hard spots and aim for bubbles that hold up large groups. Dropping a big cluster clears the board faster than popping small sets.

faq.q: Are bubble shooter games good for young kids?
faq.a: Yes, they are calm, colorful and need only a mouse or a tap. They also practice color matching and aiming.

faq.q: Can I play bubble shooter on my phone?
faq.a: Bubble shooters are played by tapping or dragging, so many work well on phones and tablets. Whether a game runs on mobile is listed on its page.

faq.q: Is classic Bubble Shooter on Pixuvo?
faq.a: Yes, Bubble Shooter and Bubble Shooter POP are both in this category, along with hundreds of variations.

building.intro:
Stack it, connect it, make it stand. Building games are for kids who like creating things and seeing a plan turn into something real on screen. Pixuvo has more than 230 building games, from calm design puzzles to survival worlds.

There are a few main styles. Construction puzzles ask you to build something that actually works, like a road or a tall stack. Survival and craft builders usually start you with almost nothing: you gather wood and stone, then build shelters and tools. Factory games are about machines and production lines, idle builders keep growing while you play, and some games mix building with defending what you made. Road Designer, Stack Rocket, Woods of Nevia: Forest Survival, Idle Island: Build And Survive and Factory Builder are a few games to try.

If you like thinking and testing, start with a construction puzzle, where trial and error is part of the fun. If you like exploring, try a survival builder. Building games often take longer, so look for ones that save progress in the browser. A mouse is the most precise choice, but many also work on tablets – the game page shows it.

faq.q: What can you build in building games?
faq.a: Almost anything: roads, rockets, houses, factories, islands and whole towns. Each game has its own goal, from solving a design puzzle to growing a settlement.

faq.q: Are there survival and crafting games here?
faq.a: Yes. Some building games let you gather resources and build up your own place step by step. Woods of Nevia: Forest Survival and Idle Island: Build And Survive are two to try.

faq.q: Which building game is good for puzzle lovers?
faq.a: Construction puzzles are great for thinkers, because you need to plan your build so it works. Not sure where to begin? Pick Road Designer or Stack Rocket.

faq.q: Do building games work on a tablet?
faq.a: Many do, though games where you place small pieces are easier with a mouse. The game page tells you whether it works on phones and tablets.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. All building games on Pixuvo are free to play in your browser.

bus.intro:
Next stop: fun. Bus games put you in the driver's seat of a big city bus, and your job is to get passengers where they need to go – safely and on time. Pixuvo has more than 350 free bus games to play in your browser.

Driving a bus is all about patience and precision. It is long, so turns need extra space, and stopping exactly at the bus stop takes practice. Simulator-style games let you follow a route through town, while parking games test how well you can fit a big vehicle into a small space. Some bus games are puzzles about moving buses out of a crowded lot. A quick way in: City Bus Simulator Driving Games, Bus Driving Master 3D, Bus Parking City 3D, City Bus Parking and Bus Parking Out.

If you are new, start with a parking game and get used to how a long bus turns – the back wheels cut the corner tighter than the front ones. Then try a route simulator, where you must stop smoothly, open the doors and keep to the road. Most bus games use the arrow keys or WASD, with extra keys for doors or the brake listed on the game page. Playing on a tablet? Many games support it, and the game page shows which ones. Bus games are part of the driving category, along with truck and parking games.

faq.q: What do you do in bus games?
faq.a: You drive a bus along a route, stop at bus stops and pick up passengers, or park a long bus in a tight space. Some bus games are puzzles about moving buses out of a busy lot.

faq.q: How do you turn a bus in bus games?
faq.a: Start the turn later and wider than in a car, because the back of the bus follows a tighter path. Go slowly so you do not hit the curb.

faq.q: What is a good bus game for beginners?
faq.a: A parking game is a good way to learn how a long bus moves – try City Bus Parking first. When you feel ready, move on to a route simulator.

faq.q: Can I play bus games on my phone?
faq.a: Many bus games have on-screen pedals and steering and work on phones and tablets. You can see on the game page whether a phone or tablet will work.

faq.q: Are bus games free to play?
faq.a: Yes, all bus games on Pixuvo are free in your browser with no sign-up.

car.intro:
From tiny karts to roaring supercars, from busy city streets to giant mega ramps – if it has four wheels, you will probably find it here. Pixuvo has more than 3,000 free car games for kids who love anything with an engine.

Car games are not only about racing. Yes, there are plenty of races, but there are also stunt games where you launch off huge ramps, drift games where you slide around corners, parking games that test careful steering, and free-driving games where you simply cruise around. If you want battles on wheels, some car games add shooting too. Car Racing, Val d'Agri Race, Kart Racer Vs, Mega Ramps Car Racing Games 3D, Russian Car Drift 3D and Parking Solution are a few to try.

How to pick? If you love speed, go for races and stunts. If you like thinking, parking puzzles are surprisingly tricky. If you want to explore, look for simulator-style driving games – the game description tells you what kind of map to expect. Most car games use the arrow keys or WASD, plus the space bar for the handbrake or boost, and the game page lists the controls. Playing on a tablet? Many games support it, and the game page shows which ones. For more speed, check out the racing category; for careful steering, try the driving category.

faq.q: What are some fun car games for kids?
faq.a: Kart Racer Vs, Car Racing, Mega Ramps Car Racing Games 3D and Parking Solution are a good mix to begin with. Try a race, a stunt game and a parking game to see which style you like best.

faq.q: Are there car games where you can drive anywhere?
faq.a: Yes, some car and driving simulator games have open maps where you cruise freely instead of following a track. The game description usually tells you.

faq.q: Can car games teach you how to drive?
faq.a: Browser car games are made for fun and do not teach real traffic rules. Parking games can be a playful way to practice steering and judging space, though.

faq.q: What keys do you use in car games?
faq.a: Most use the arrow keys or WASD to steer and accelerate, and often the space bar for the handbrake or boost. The game page lists the exact controls.

faq.q: Can I play car games on a tablet?
faq.a: Many car games have touch buttons and work on phones and tablets. You can see on the game page whether a phone or tablet will work.

card.intro:
Shuffle, deal, and see what lands in your hand. Card games combine a bit of luck with a lot of smart choices, and Pixuvo has more than 420 of them, from classic solitaire to fantasy battles with collectible cards.

The quiet favorite is solitaire, which has its own section – Ultimate Solitaire Classic is a good place to start. Color-matching games follow the familiar idea of playing a card that matches by color or number, and multiplayer versions let you play with others. Battle card games turn cards into heroes and monsters that fight on a board, and memory card games ask you to flip cards and remember where each pair is. 4 Colors PGS, Four Colors Multiplayer Monument Edition, Battle Card Monster, Emberdeck and Flip & Match are a few games to try.

If you are new to card games, try a memory game first – it is simple and great for younger kids. For older players, color-matching games teach quick decisions, and battle card games are all about building a good deck and planning a few turns ahead. Card games are usually played with clicks or taps, so they work comfortably on computers, tablets and many phones – the game page tells you whether it works on phones and tablets.

faq.q: What card games can kids play online?
faq.a: Solitaire, color-matching games, memory games and battle card games are all good choices for kids. Not sure where to begin? Pick Ultimate Solitaire Classic, 4 Colors PGS or Flip & Match.

faq.q: What are 2 player card games I can play here?

faq.q: What are battle card games?
faq.a: In battle card games, each card is a hero, monster or spell. You build a deck and play cards to defeat your opponent, so planning is just as important as luck.

faq.q: Do card games involve real money?
faq.a: No. Card games on Pixuvo are just for fun, and any coins or chips in them are pretend. Games with gambling wording are held back for manual review.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. All card games on Pixuvo are free and run in the browser without signing up.

casual.intro:
Got five minutes before dinner? That is exactly what casual games are made for. They are short, light and easy to understand, so you can jump in, have fun and stop whenever you like. Pixuvo has more than 10,000 free casual games, all running in the browser with no sign-up.

Casual games come in many flavors. Some are one-touch timing games where you tap to hop, float or dodge. Others are small physics puzzles, like Cut The Rope 2, where you cut ropes in the right order to feed a hungry little monster. You will also find satisfying break-and-smash games, quirky one-off ideas and quick number games. Nova Hop, Boost Balloon, Dodge the Bull, BreakIt and Master of Numbers are a few more to try. Many of these are "hyper casual," meaning a single simple action repeated with rising difficulty.

The best way to choose is to look at the thumbnail and title and simply try one – if it does not click within a minute, there are thousands more. Casual games are great for younger kids, for winding down after homework and for grown-ups who want a quick break. Most need just a mouse click, the space bar or a tap, and many of them also run on phones and tablets – each game page tells you if it does. Save the ones you like to favorites, which stay in this browser.

faq.q: What are casual games?
faq.a: Casual games are simple, short games with easy rules that anyone can pick up in a minute. You can play for a few minutes and stop at any time.

faq.q: What are hyper casual games?
faq.a: Hyper casual games are an even simpler kind of casual game, usually built on one action such as tapping, swiping or timing a jump, repeated as the game gets harder.

faq.q: What casual games are good for younger kids?
faq.a: One-touch games and gentle physics puzzles like Cut The Rope 2 are easy to understand, and Boost Balloon is another good one to start with. They need only a click or a tap.

faq.q: Can I play casual games on a tablet?
faq.a: Many casual games are made for touch, so lots of them work on phones and tablets. Check the game page to see if it runs on your device.

faq.q: Do I need an account to play?
faq.a: No. Casual games on Pixuvo are free, and your favorites and recently played games are saved in your browser without an account.

chess.intro:
Sixteen pieces each, sixty-four squares, and endless possibilities. Chess has been played for well over a thousand years, and it is still one of the best games for learning to think ahead. Pixuvo's chess section has 35 chess games and variants.

If you want the classic game, start with Classic Chess Duel, ChessT or Chess Online. Chess Online and Chess Multiplayer Online are worth a look when you want a human opponent – the game page shows the available modes – and Checkmate Game and Chess of the Middle Ages are more to try. You can also travel around the world: Shogi Japanese Chess and Xiangqi Chinese Chess Duel are the Japanese and Chinese cousins of chess, with different pieces and rules. Chess Ops and Pawn Chess are two more games in the section.

Just learning? Play against the computer first, if the game offers it, and learn how each piece moves before you worry about tricky plans. A good beginner habit is to ask before every move: "What is my opponent threatening?" Chess is turn-based, so there is no hurry, and it works well with a mouse or a finger. Many chess games run on tablets and phones too – you can see on the game page whether a phone or tablet will work.

faq.q: How many possible chess games are there?
faq.a: So many that nobody can count them all: mathematicians estimate the number of possible chess games is far larger than the number of atoms in the known universe. That is why no two games are ever quite the same.

faq.q: Can I play chess online against another person?
faq.a: Some chess games have online modes for playing against other people – Chess Multiplayer Online is one to check, and the game page shows the available modes. You can also play against the computer or with a friend on the same device in many chess games.

faq.q: What is the best way for kids to learn chess?
faq.a: Start with how each piece moves, then play full games against the computer at an easy level. Checkmate puzzles, where you look for the winning move, are great practice too.

faq.q: What are Shogi and Xiangqi?
faq.a: They are the Japanese and Chinese versions of chess. Both have their own pieces and rules, and you can try them in Shogi Japanese Chess and Xiangqi Chinese Chess Duel.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. Every chess game on Pixuvo is free and opens in your browser without signing up.

clicker.intro:
Click once, earn a coin. Click a hundred times, buy an upgrade that clicks for you. That simple loop is why clicker games are so popular – Pixuvo has more than 2,300 of them, and they are easy to start for any age.

Clickers come in all kinds of themes. Some are pure classics where you tap one big object, others are about mining for resources, and some add merging or calm, satisfying effects. There are also case-opening clickers, where you open virtual boxes to collect items – it is just pretend, with no real money involved. Good ones to start with: Snail Clicker, Mantis Clicker, Candy Clicker 2, MineClicker and Lotl Spa.

The trick to any clicker is choosing upgrades well. Early on, buy upgrades that make each click stronger; later, focus on automatic helpers that earn while you rest your finger. Clicker games work with just a mouse, a touchpad or a finger, so they are among the easiest games to play on phones and tablets – whether a game runs on mobile is listed on its page. If you like clickers, you might also enjoy our idle games.

faq.q: What are clicker games?
faq.a: Clicker games are games where you click or tap to earn points or coins, then spend them on upgrades that help you earn faster. They are also called incremental games.

faq.q: How do you get better at clicker games?
faq.a: Buy upgrades that boost every click first, then switch to automatic helpers. Upgrading what earns the most for the price is usually the smartest choice.

faq.q: What is the difference between clicker and idle games?
faq.a: In a clicker you earn mostly by clicking yourself, while idle games keep earning on their own. Many games start as clickers and turn into idle games once you unlock helpers.

faq.q: Can I play clicker games on my phone?
faq.a: Yes, many clicker games only need taps, so they work nicely on phones and tablets. You can see on the game page whether a phone or tablet will work.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. All clicker games on Pixuvo are free to play in the browser, and any coins or items inside them are pretend.

coloring.intro:
A blank page, a box of colors and no rules about staying inside the lines. Coloring and drawing games are the digital version of a coloring book – except you never run out of crayons. Pixuvo has more than 1,500 of them.

Coloring books are the heart of the section. Butterfly Coloring Pages Kids and Mandala Coloring Book offer pictures to color any way you like, and some books feature favorite characters, like Italian Brainrot Coloring. Color-by-number games, such as Color Pixels - Coloring by Numbers, show which color goes where, so the picture appears step by step – very relaxing. Then there are drawing puzzles, where your line is the solution, like Draw The Path - Puzzle. Poly Art, Wall Painter and Creative Puzzle are more creative picks to try.

For younger kids, coloring pages with big areas are the best start, while older kids often enjoy detailed mandalas or pixel art. Drawing games are a calm activity after a busy day, and no one will ever tell you that the sky has to be blue. They work beautifully with a finger on a tablet, and many also run on phones and computers – each game page shows if touch screens are supported.

faq.q: Are there free online coloring pages for kids?
faq.a: Yes, there are many coloring books, like Butterfly Coloring Pages Kids and Mandala Coloring Book, that you can color right in the browser for free.

faq.q: What is color by number?
faq.a: In color-by-number games, each area has a number that matches a color. You fill them in one by one, and the picture appears as you go – great for relaxing.

faq.q: Can I draw my own pictures?
faq.a: Some games let you draw freely, while others use drawing as a puzzle, like Draw The Path - Puzzle. Check the game description to see which kind it is.

faq.q: Are coloring games good on a tablet?
faq.a: Yes, coloring with a finger on a tablet feels natural, and many coloring games support touch screens. Each game page shows if touch screens are supported.

faq.q: Can I print or save my coloring?
faq.a: Some coloring games have a save button, but not all of them. If yours does not, you can take a screenshot of your finished picture.

cooking.intro:
Orders are coming in, the grill is hot, and the customers are hungry. Cooking games put you in the kitchen, and with almost 900 of them on Pixuvo, you can make everything from burgers and pizza to tacos and steak.

There are two main kinds. Restaurant and time-management games are fast: customers arrive, you prepare their orders and serve them before they lose patience. These are all about speed and good organization. Recipe games are slower and more creative – you choose ingredients and prepare the food step by step, the way you would at home. Some games mix both and let you run a café or restaurant and make it grow. Burger Restaurant Simulator 3D, Pizza Maker food Cooking Games, Yummy Taco, Marmot Diner Dash and Taste City are good first picks, and Multiplayer Cooking Coop is one to try with a friend.

Younger kids usually enjoy recipe games most, because there is no timer. For restaurant games, a good trick is to prepare popular items before customers ask for them. Cooking games are played with clicks, drags or taps, so many work nicely on tablets and phones – check the game page to see if it runs on your device. And if a game makes you hungry, maybe it is time to cook something real with a grown-up!

faq.q: What are good cooking games for kids?
faq.a: Younger kids usually like calm recipe games, while older kids often enjoy fast restaurant games. To get going, try Pizza Maker food Cooking Games, Yummy Taco and Marmot Diner Dash.

faq.q: Where can I play free online cooking games?
faq.a: Right here – every cooking game on Pixuvo is free and opens in your browser with no sign-up or download.

faq.q: What is a restaurant time-management game?
faq.a: It is a cooking game where customers arrive with orders and you have to cook and serve quickly. Planning ahead and serving in the right order helps you earn more.

faq.q: Can we cook together in a cooking game?
faq.a: Some games are made for teamwork – Multiplayer Cooking Coop is one to check. The game page shows whether a game supports more than one player.

faq.q: Can I play cooking games on a tablet?
faq.a: Yes, many cooking games use simple taps and drags and work well on tablets and phones. Each game page shows if touch screens are supported.

dress-up.intro:
Pick an outfit, try a new hairstyle, add accessories, and create a look that is all yours. Dress-up games are about creativity and style, and with more than 2,800 of them, there is plenty to explore.

Fashion and makeover games are the classics: you choose clothes, makeup and accessories for a character or a special event, and some add nail designs or a K-pop theme. Try Doll Queen Designer, Anime Girl Fashion Make Up, Model Wedding - Girl Games or Aidol K-pop Adventure. The section also includes care games, where you look after cute characters, pets or babies. Baby Panda Care, Funny Kitty Care, Stacky Dash Nail, Funny Rescue Gardener and Funny Rescue Carpenter are more picks to try.

There is no wrong answer in dress-up games – the fun is in experimenting. Try matching colors one day and wild combinations the next, then take a screenshot of your favorite look. Dress-up games are loved by many kids of every gender, and anyone can enjoy styling and designing. They need only clicks or taps, so most are easy to play on tablets and phones; you can see on the game page whether a phone or tablet will work.

faq.q: What are dress-up games?
faq.a: Dress-up games let you choose clothes, hairstyles, makeup and accessories for a character. Some also include caring for pets or babies, decorating, or designing your own outfits.

faq.q: Are there dress-up games for boys?
faq.a: Yes – dress-up games are for everyone. Styling, designing and caring games are enjoyed by kids of every gender, and many have themes like jobs, K-pop or animals.

faq.q: Which dress-up games are good for younger kids?
faq.a: Care games are usually simple and sweet, so they are a gentle start. To get going, try Baby Panda Care, Funny Kitty Care and Doll Queen Designer.

faq.q: Can I save my outfit?
faq.a: It depends on the game. If there is no save button, you can take a screenshot of your favorite look.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. All dress-up games on Pixuvo are free to play in the browser, with no account needed.

drift.intro:
Turn in, tap the brake, and let the back of the car slide around the corner in a cloud of smoke. Drifting is one of the coolest skills in car games, and these games are built around it. Pixuvo offers more than 650 free drift games in the browser.

In most drift games you earn points for how long and how sideways you slide, and keeping a drift going from one corner to the next builds a combo. Some games stick to classic sliding on a track with different kinds of cars, while others mix drifting with chases or unusual vehicles. GT Drift Most Wanted, Bimmer Drifting Legends, Vaz Drifting Legends, Get Drifty, Drift Cops 3D and Drift Bus are a few games to try.

Drifting takes practice, so do not worry if you spin out at first. The basic idea is to enter a corner with speed, start the slide with the handbrake or a quick turn, and then gently steer the other way to stay in control. Small steering moves work better than big ones. Most drift games use the arrow keys or WASD with the space bar as the handbrake; the game page lists the controls. On a phone or tablet? Many games run there too; look for it on the game page. Drift games are part of the racing category.

faq.q: What is drifting in car games?
faq.a: Drifting means sliding the car sideways through a corner while staying in control. Drift games give points for long, stylish slides.

faq.q: How do you drift in drift games?
faq.a: Go into a corner with speed, start the slide with the handbrake (often the space bar) and steer gently the opposite way to hold it. Small, smooth steering is the key.

faq.q: What drift game should I try first?
faq.a: Get Drifty and GT Drift Most Wanted are listed near the top of the category. Start with short practice runs and work up to longer drifts.

faq.q: Can I play drift games on my phone?
faq.a: Many drift games have touch controls and run on phones and tablets. The game page shows if mobile is supported.

faq.q: Are drift games free?
faq.a: Yes, every drift game on Pixuvo is free to play in the browser with no download.

driving.intro:
Racing is about being first. Driving is about being good at it: steering smoothly, braking at the right moment and getting where you need to go in one piece. Pixuvo has more than 2,500 free driving games for kids who love being behind the wheel.

This category is home to several kinds of driving. Parking games challenge you to fit a car into a tight space without scratching it. Truck games put you in charge of heavy vehicles, cargo and bumpy roads. Bus games ask you to stop at the right places and pick up passengers. There are also highway and endless-road games, where you weave through traffic, and stunt games with ramps and big jumps. Final Freeway, Final Freeway 2R, Road Fury, Truck Simulator Stunt Extreme and Italian Brainrot Extreme Driver are easy places to start.

If you want a calm challenge, start with a parking game – it teaches you how the car turns. If you prefer speed, try a highway game, where the goal is to keep driving as long as you can without crashing. Most driving games use the arrow keys or WASD, with the space bar to brake. Many of them also run on phones and tablets – each game page tells you if it does. Remember that games are for fun: real driving needs lessons and road rules. For pure speed, head to the racing category.

faq.q: What are driving games?
faq.a: Driving games are about controlling a vehicle well – steering, braking, parking and following a route. They are usually calmer than racing games.

faq.q: Do driving games teach you how to drive a car?
faq.a: No, browser driving games are just for fun and do not replace real lessons or road rules. They can help kids get a feel for steering and judging distance.

faq.q: What driving game should I try first?
faq.a: A parking game is a great start because it teaches how the car turns. Final Freeway and Road Fury are good ones to try next.

faq.q: What kinds of vehicles can I drive?
faq.a: Cars, trucks, buses and more. Check the parking, truck and bus subcategories to find them quickly.

faq.q: Can I play driving games on my phone?
faq.a: Many driving games have on-screen pedals and steering, and work on phones and tablets. Each game page shows if touch screens are supported.

educational.intro:
Learning sticks better when it is fun. Educational games mix play with real skills like reading, counting, caring for your body or understanding nature. Pixuvo has more than 1,300 games that teach something along the way.

For the youngest players, there are games with first words, letters and simple counting. Health and care games teach good habits like brushing your teeth, nature games look at the environment in a playful way, and cooking games practice following steps in the right order. Puzzles train patience and attention. Try My First 100 Words, App For Kids - Edu games, Doctor Teeth, Save The Planet and Yummy Cupcake. For more practice in one area, our math and memory games are great companions.

How to choose? Think about what your child is learning right now – letters, numbers, words or habits – and pick a game that matches. Short sessions of 10 to 15 minutes, followed by a little chat about what they discovered, work well. Most educational games use simple clicks or taps, so they are easy on tablets and phones too – each game page shows if touch screens are supported.

faq.q: What are the best educational games for kids?
faq.a: It depends on age: preschoolers can start with simple word and letter games – My First 100 Words is a good one to start with – while older kids might enjoy logic puzzles, quizzes, and our math and memory games.

faq.q: Do educational games actually help kids learn?
faq.a: Good educational games make practice fun, which helps kids repeat skills more often. They work best alongside reading, school and talking with grown-ups, not instead of them.

faq.q: Are there educational games for preschoolers?
faq.a: Yes. Simple word, letter and coloring games suit young children, especially with a parent nearby – My First 100 Words and App For Kids - Edu games are two to try.

faq.q: Can my child play educational games on a tablet?
faq.a: Many educational games use simple taps and work well on tablets. Check the game page to see if it runs on your device.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. All educational games on Pixuvo are free, with no account and nothing to install.

escape.intro:
The door is locked, the key is missing and there is a strange code scratched on the wall. Escape games hand you a puzzle box and one goal: get out. Pixuvo offers more than 2,000 free escape games, from classic escape rooms to obby-style runs and prison breaks.

The classic type is the point-and-click escape room. You click around the scene, collect items, combine them and crack codes. Some are door-by-door series where each new room gets a little harder. Prison break games add a story about sneaking past guards, and obby escapes are more about jumping across an obstacle course than finding clues, so they suit kids who prefer moving to thinking. Good ones to try include 100 Doors - Escape from Prison, Prison Jail Escaping Game, Cool Escape Obby Man and Knock and Run. 100 Doors Escape.

The golden rule of escape games: look at everything twice. Click corners, open drawers, zoom in on pictures and remember any numbers or colors you see, because they usually unlock something later. A notepad next to the keyboard really helps. Most escape rooms need only a mouse or a finger, which makes them friendly for touch screens, and lots of these games work on a phone or tablet too; check the game page to be sure. Escape games are part of the bigger adventure category if you want more exploring.

faq.q: How do escape room games work?
faq.a: You are stuck in a room and must find hidden items, combine them and solve codes or puzzles to open the exit. Most are played by clicking or tapping on objects.

faq.q: What are good escape games for beginners?
faq.a: Door-by-door series usually start easy and get harder slowly, so they are a good way to learn how escape puzzles think. 100 Doors - Escape from Prison is a good one to start with.

faq.q: What should I do if I get stuck in an escape game?
faq.a: Click every corner again, check your inventory and try combining items. Writing down numbers, colors and symbols you have seen often reveals the solution.

faq.q: What is an obby escape game?
faq.a: An obby is an obstacle course. In obby escape games you reach the exit by running and jumping over obstacles instead of solving clues.

faq.q: Can I play escape games on my phone?
faq.a: Escape rooms mostly need only taps, so many work well on phones and tablets. Each game page shows if touch screens are supported.

farming.intro:
Plant the seeds, water them, and come back for the harvest. Farming games are cozy and calm, which is why many kids (and parents) love them after a busy day. Pixuvo has more than 240 farming games.

Most of them mix a few activities. Crop games are about planting, watering and picking vegetables, fruit or flowers. Animal games let you feed and care for chickens, cows or pets. Tractor games put you in the driver's seat to plow and carry loads, and some farming games are little worlds where you farm, build and trade at your own speed. Garden Master, Happy Farm, Tractor Simulator Farming Game, A day in the countryside and Island Farm Cat Gardener are a few games to try.

If you want something relaxing, start with a garden game where nothing can go wrong. If you like driving, try a tractor simulator. Farming games often reward coming back regularly, and some save your farm in the browser on the device you use. Most need only clicks or taps, so they are easy to play on tablets and phones too – the game page tells you whether it works on phones and tablets.

faq.q: What are farming games?
faq.a: Farming games let you grow crops, care for animals and sometimes drive tractors. They are usually calm and focus on building up your farm over time.

faq.q: Which farming games are good for younger kids?
faq.a: Gentle garden and animal games are a good start, and many farming games have little time pressure, which suits younger players. Good ones to start with: Garden Master, Happy Farm and Island Farm Cat Gardener.

faq.q: Are there tractor games here?
faq.a: Yes – Tractor Simulator Farming Game is one to try, and you can find more vehicles in our driving and truck sections.

faq.q: Will my farm be saved?
faq.a: Many farming games save your progress in the browser on the same device. If you clear browser data or use another device, you may have to start again.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. Every farming game on Pixuvo is free and runs in the browser without sign-up.

fighting.intro:
One-on-one duels, crowded arenas and knockout punches – fighting games are about reading your opponent and striking first. Pixuvo collects more than 1,000 free fighting games you can play in the browser, and many of them are made for two players sharing one keyboard.

Not every fighting game feels the same. Stickman fighters keep the graphics simple so all the attention goes to timing your kicks and combos; Stickman Warriors and Stickman Street Fighting 3D are good examples. Arena and party fighters are sillier, with more shoving and bouncing than serious combat. Then there are merge-and-battle games, which mix merging with battles – a nice choice for kids who prefer planning over button mashing. Sumo Shove, Knockback Knights and Gladiators Merge and Fight are more games to try.

A good way to improve is to learn just two or three moves well instead of pressing everything at once. Blocking at the right moment often wins more fights than attacking. On a computer, check the game page for the control layout before you start, especially in 2 player mode. Plenty of them work on phones and tablets as well – the game page says so. If you want more fast reflex games, the wider action category is the next stop.

faq.q: What are the best fighting games for kids?
faq.a: Party-style fighters are a lighthearted start, and simple stickman fighters are a good next step. Sumo Shove, Knockback Knights and Stickman Warriors are good examples.

faq.q: Can I play fighting games with a friend on the same computer?
faq.a: Yes, many fighting games have a 2 player mode on one keyboard, usually WASD for one player and the arrow keys for the other. The game page shows when two players are supported.

faq.q: How do I get better at fighting games?
faq.a: Learn a few moves really well, practice blocking and watch what your opponent does before you attack. Short practice rounds help more than one long session.

faq.q: What is a stickman fighting game?
faq.a: It is a fighting game where the characters are simple stick figures. Because the graphics are simple, the fun comes from timing, combos and physics.

faq.q: Are fighting games free on Pixuvo?
faq.a: Yes, all fighting games on Pixuvo are free to play in the browser with no account and nothing to install.

first-person-shooter.intro:
In a first-person shooter, you do not watch the hero – you are the hero. The camera sits right behind your eyes, so every corner you turn and every target you spot feels close and real. Pixuvo has more than 150 free first-person shooter (FPS) games that play straight in the browser.

FPS games usually come in a few flavors: mission games with objectives to complete level by level, battleground games on larger maps, and arena shooters built on fast rounds and quick aim. Games listed near the top include Frontline Assault: Battleground Fire Max Shooting, Commando Force 2, Strykon and Battle Shot Elite, plus FPS Sniper Shooting: Production Facility, Border Battleground, Battleops and Vexon. If you want something lighter, look for cartoon-style shooters that keep things goofy rather than gritty.

FPS games are easiest with a mouse and keyboard: WASD to move, the mouse to look and aim, left click to fire and often right click to aim down the sights. A tip for beginners is to keep your crosshair at head height while you walk, so you need less movement to aim when something appears. Check the game page for controls; some games also work on phones and tablets, and the game page shows it. Many FPS games are realistic in style and better suited to older kids – games with violent wording are held for manual review, and our parents page explains how we check them. More shooters wait in the shooting category.

faq.q: What is a first-person shooter?
faq.a: A first-person shooter (FPS) is a shooting game where you see the world through your character's eyes. You usually only see your hands and weapon on the screen.

faq.q: What are the controls for FPS games?
faq.a: Most use WASD to move, the mouse to look around, left click to shoot and right click to aim down the sights. The game page lists the exact controls.

faq.q: Which FPS game is best for beginners?
faq.a: Look for mission-based games with short levels, so you can learn step by step. Cartoon-style shooters are a lighter choice for younger players.

faq.q: Can I play FPS games without downloading anything?
faq.a: Yes, FPS games on Pixuvo run directly in the web browser, with no download or install.

faq.q: Are FPS games suitable for kids?
faq.a: It depends on the game – some are cartoony, others are realistic war games better for older kids. Parents can read our parents page to see how games are reviewed.

football.intro:
One kick, one goal, and the crowd goes wild. Football (called soccer in the US) is the most popular sport on the planet, and Pixuvo has more than 590 football games you can play right in your browser.

The most common type is the penalty and free kick game. You aim, choose the power and try to beat the goalkeeper or a wall of defenders and score with one perfect shot. Headball games are fast, funny one-on-one matches where big-headed players jump and head the ball, and they are often great for two players. Running games add dodging and dribbling. Curve Kick, Penalty Challenge, Power Free Kick, Soccer Dash and Anime Headball are easy places to start.

If you are new, start with a penalty game, because it teaches aim and power with just the mouse or a swipe. When you want a real opponent, try a headball match with a friend on the same keyboard. Most football games are quick, so you can play a whole match in a few minutes. Many also work on phones and tablets – the game page shows it.

faq.q: How long are soccer games?
faq.a: A real professional match lasts 90 minutes, played in two halves of 45 minutes. Browser football games are much shorter: a penalty round or a headball match usually takes just a few minutes.

faq.q: Is this football or soccer?
faq.a: It is soccer – the game played with a round ball and goals. In most of the world it is called football, which is why the section has that name.

faq.q: What are headball games?
faq.a: They are one-on-one matches with cartoon players who have giant heads. You jump, kick and head the ball into the goal, and many can be played by two people on one keyboard – the game page shows when two players are supported.

faq.q: Which football game is best for practicing penalties?
faq.a: Penalty Challenge, Shoot Up Penalty Kicks and Penalty Shoot Pro World Cup are good ones to start with, and Curve Kick and Power Free Kick are more to try.

faq.q: Can I play football games on a tablet?
faq.a: Many football games use simple swipes to shoot, so they work nicely on tablets and phones. Each game page shows if touch screens are supported.

golf.intro:
Tap, roll, and watch the ball curve toward the hole. Golf games are some of the most relaxing games on Pixuvo – no timer chasing you, just you, the ball and a tricky course. There are almost 100 of them, so you can try something new every day.

Mini golf is a great place to start. Courses have ramps, walls, windmills and funny obstacles, and the goal is to get the ball in with as few strokes as possible. Little Golf, Golf Mini, Mini Golf 2 and Mini Golf 18 For Kids are good first courses. Golf Orbit, Golf - World Challenge, Sunny Golf, Tap & Putt and Oh My Golf are more to try. Some golf games are calm putting puzzles, others are about long, powerful drives.

Remember the main rule: fewer strokes is better. The number you are trying to beat is called "par". Before each shot, look at where the ball will bounce off the walls, and use small, soft taps when you are close. Golf games usually need only a mouse or a finger, which makes them great on tablets and phones too – you can see on the game page whether a phone or tablet will work.

faq.q: What is a good mini golf game for kids?
faq.a: Mini Golf 18 For Kids, Little Golf and Golf Mini are good ones to start with, and Mini Golf 2 is another to try. When you are just learning, look for short holes and clear aiming lines.

faq.q: What does "par" mean in golf?
faq.a: Par is the number of strokes a good player should need to finish a hole. Taking fewer strokes than par is great, and taking more means you can try to improve next time.

faq.q: How do I hit the ball the right distance?
faq.a: In most golf games you drag or hold to set the power and release to shoot. Use short, soft shots near the hole – too much power is the most common reason for missing.

faq.q: Can I play golf games on my phone or tablet?
faq.a: Many golf games use one tap or a simple drag, so they work well on touch screens. The game page tells you whether it works on phones and tablets.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. All golf games on Pixuvo are free, with no sign-up and nothing to download.

hidden-object.intro:
Somewhere in this messy room is a key, a teacup and a tiny golden bird. Can you spot them before time runs out? Hidden object games are all about sharp eyes and patience, and Pixuvo has more than 300 of them to play free in your browser.

Most games give you a list of items and a detailed picture full of clutter. You click each object once you find it, and some games add hints, timers or bonus points for finding things fast. Find-the-difference games like Italian Brainrot: Find the Difference show two almost identical pictures and ask you to spot what changed. Longer hidden object adventures link many scenes into a mystery, and a few have a spooky atmosphere, so they are better for older kids. Hidden Objects Lost Island 2, Hidden Object Emily's Case and Hidden Objects Vacation in Brazil are a few to try.

Here is a tip: do not stare at the whole picture at once. Scan it in sections, like reading a page from left to right, and look for shapes instead of colors. Use hints when you are really stuck rather than clicking randomly, since many games take points away for wrong clicks. A mouse or a finger is all you need, and plenty of them work on phones and tablets as well – the game page says so. Hidden object games live inside the puzzle category.

faq.q: What is a hidden object game?
faq.a: It is a puzzle game where you search a busy picture for a list of items. Some versions ask you to spot the differences between two pictures instead.

faq.q: How do you get better at hidden object games?
faq.a: Scan the picture in small sections and look for the outline of each item, not just its color. Save hints for when you are truly stuck.

faq.q: Are hidden object games good for kids?
faq.a: They train attention, patience and observation. Some story games have spooky themes, so younger kids may prefer lighter find-the-difference games.

faq.q: What is the difference between hidden object and spot the difference games?
faq.a: Hidden object games give you a list of things to find in one scene, while spot the difference games show two pictures and ask what changed. Both are in this category.

faq.q: Can I play hidden object games on a tablet?
faq.a: Yes, many work well with a finger on phones and tablets. Whether a game runs on mobile is listed on its page.

horror.intro:
Creaky doors, dark hallways, and something moving in the shadows. This section is for players who like a little thrill and a good jump scare – the kind of spooky fun many kids enjoy around Halloween or at a sleepover. Pixuvo has more than 200 horror games.

Many of them are spooky adventures and escape games, where you explore creepy places, find clues and try to get out. Some use funny meme characters, and others lean on classic spooky themes like dolls, graveyards and haunted houses. The malevolent mansion of evil, Exhibit of Sorrows, Cursed Dreams, Floppa Scary Horror and Scary Doll are easy places to start.

Not everyone likes being scared, and that is completely fine. Horror games can include jump scares, scary sounds and dark pictures, so they are better for older kids, and parents should take a look before younger children play. Playing with the lights on, or together with a friend, helps! Games with violent or adult wording are held for manual review before they appear, and our parents page explains more. Many horror games work best on a computer with headphones; each game page shows if touch screens are supported.

faq.q: Are horror games OK for kids?
faq.a: It depends on the child. Many games here are mild spooky adventures, but some have jump scares and dark pictures, so they are better for older kids, and parents should check first. Our parents page has more tips.

faq.q: What is the least scary horror game here?
faq.a: Games built around funny meme characters are often more silly than scary. Still, every game is different, so try a game together first if you are unsure.

faq.q: What is a jump scare?
faq.a: A jump scare is a sudden picture or loud sound that makes you jump. It is a trick many horror games use, so turning the volume down can make a game less intense.

faq.q: Are there escape room horror games?
faq.a: Yes, many horror games are about exploring spooky places and solving puzzles to escape. The malevolent mansion of evil and Exhibit of Sorrows are two horror games to look at.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. All horror games on Pixuvo are free, and they run in the browser with no sign-up.

idle.intro:
Here is a game style that keeps playing even when you take your hands off the keyboard. In idle games, your mines, workers or factories keep producing while you wait, and when you come back, there is a pile of coins ready for the next upgrade. Pixuvo has 250 idle games.

The idea is always similar: start small, earn, upgrade, grow faster. The setting is what makes each one different: you might dig deeper and deeper, turn a few trees into a whole forest business, gather resources to grow a base or a kingdom, or merge cars and race them. Drill to the Core, Lumberjack Idle, Idle Craft 3D, Dominations Idle and Idle Merge Car and Race are a few games listed near the top, and Little Commander - Red vs Blue and Frozenventure are more worth a look.

Idle games are great for players who like seeing progress without fast reflexes. They are also easy to fit around other things: check in, buy a few upgrades, and come back later. A simple tip – upgrade whatever earns the most per coin spent. Many idle games save progress in the browser on the device you use, so stick to the same device. They need only clicks or taps, so they often work well on phones and tablets; whether a game runs on mobile is listed on its page.

faq.q: What is an idle game?
faq.a: An idle game is a game where your progress keeps going even when you are not actively playing. You buy upgrades that earn coins automatically, then use those coins to grow even faster.

faq.q: What is the difference between idle and clicker games?
faq.a: In clicker games you earn mainly by clicking yourself, while idle games earn on their own over time. Many games mix both: you click at the start and things become automatic later.

faq.q: Does an idle game keep earning when I close the page?
faq.a: Some idle games count the time you were away and give you coins when you return, but not all of them do. It depends on the game.

faq.q: Which idle games should I try first?
faq.a: Drill to the Core, Lumberjack Idle and Idle Merge Car and Race are three easy ones to begin with. Try a few for a couple of minutes and keep the one whose theme you like best.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. All idle games on Pixuvo are free to play, with no account needed.

io.intro:
Start tiny, grow huge, and try not to get eaten. That is the spirit of .io games, a style of browser game where many players jump into the same arena and compete in quick rounds. Pixuvo has more than 1,800 games in the .io style.

The name comes from the ".io" web address used by early hits like Agar.io and Slither.io. Since then, ".io" has become a label for any simple, fast arena game you can join in seconds. In snake and worm games you eat and grow longer, in blob games you get bigger and stronger by collecting things and outsmarting others, and there are party styles with races, battles and hide-and-seek. Worm Hunt - Snake game iO zone, Blob Wars, Evo Pit, Diep.io, Hide N Seek.io and Fallingman.io are a few games to try.

The best thing about .io games is how quick they are: if you lose, you start a new round in seconds. Learn by watching bigger players and staying near the edges at first. Most .io games are played with a mouse or arrow keys, and some work on phones and tablets too – the game page shows it. Many .io games are online, so remind kids never to share personal information with other players.

faq.q: What does .io mean in games?
faq.a: ".io" is originally a web address ending, like .com. It became a game label after early hits such as Agar.io and Slither.io, so today it means simple, fast arena games you can join in seconds.

faq.q: What are .io games?
faq.a: They are quick browser games where you compete in an arena, usually by growing bigger, collecting points or outlasting other players. Each round is short, so you can play again right away.

faq.q: What are some good .io games to start with?
faq.a: Worm Hunt - Snake game iO zone, Diep.io, Hide N Seek.io and Fallingman.io are good first picks. Rounds are short, so trying a few is easy.

faq.q: Are .io games played against real people?
faq.a: Many .io games are online with other players, while some use computer opponents. Parents can check a game first and remind kids not to share personal information.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. All .io games on Pixuvo are free and open in your browser without an account.

jigsaw.intro:
There is nothing quite like clicking the last piece into place and seeing the whole picture appear. Online jigsaw games give you that feeling without losing pieces under the sofa. Pixuvo has more than 1,500 free jigsaw puzzles to play in the browser.

The pictures cover almost anything kids like: animals in Animal Explorer Puzzle and Axolotl Jigsaw Picture Puzzle, aliens in Small Aliens - Jigsaw, seasonal scenes in Halloween Puzzle, and sports in Gymnastics Jigsaw Jam. Puzzles for Kids and Jigsaw Sort are more to try, and some games twist the classic idea, so you can switch styles when you want something new.

The trick that real puzzle fans use works online too: start with the edges and corners, then sort the rest by color. Many games let you pick how many pieces you want, so begin with a small number and move up as you get faster. Some also show a ghost image of the finished picture in the background – a great help for beginners. Jigsaws are calm and quiet, which makes them nice for winding down or for playing side by side with a parent. You need only a mouse or a finger to drag pieces, and lots of these games work on a phone or tablet too; check the game page to be sure. For more brain games, visit the full puzzle category.

faq.q: What are good jigsaw puzzles for young kids?
faq.a: Puzzles for Kids and animal puzzles like Animal Explorer Puzzle are a friendly choice and a gentle start for younger children. Pick a small number of pieces when the game lets you.

faq.q: How do you solve a jigsaw puzzle faster?
faq.a: Build the border first, then group the remaining pieces by color or pattern. Look at the finished picture often to know where each part belongs.

faq.q: Can I choose how many pieces a jigsaw has?
faq.a: Many jigsaw games let you pick the number of pieces before you start. Begin small and try more pieces once you get quicker.

faq.q: Do online jigsaw puzzles work on tablets?
faq.a: Dragging pieces with a finger works nicely on touch screens, and many jigsaws run on phones and tablets. The game page shows if mobile is supported.

faq.q: Are jigsaw games free on Pixuvo?
faq.a: Yes, all jigsaw puzzles on Pixuvo are free to play in the browser with no sign-up.

mahjong.intro:
Find two matching tiles, click them, and watch them disappear. Mahjong solitaire is calm, colorful and great for training your eyes. Pixuvo has almost 300 mahjong games.

Most of them follow the same simple rule: you may only remove a pair of matching tiles if each tile is free – nothing on top of it and at least one side open. The goal is to clear the whole layout. Some versions keep the traditional tiles, while others use fresh themes and pictures. Mahjong Connect games work a bit differently: tiles are flat on the board, and you can match two if they can be linked with a line that turns no more than twice. Others add stacking or sorting twists. Good ones to start with: Mahjong Classical, Mahjong Garden, Mahjong Sweet Connection, Mahjong Pair Up and Mahjong Tower.

A good beginner strategy is to clear tiles from the tallest stacks and the long rows first, because they block the most other tiles. Use hints if the game has them – there is no shame in learning! Mahjong is played with clicks or taps and has no time pressure in most versions, so it works on computers, tablets and many phones; whether a game runs on mobile is listed on its page.

faq.q: How do you play mahjong solitaire?
faq.a: Click two matching tiles that are free – not covered and open on the left or right side – to remove them. You win when the whole layout is cleared.

faq.q: What is the difference between mahjong and Mahjong Connect?
faq.a: In mahjong solitaire, tiles are stacked in layers. In Mahjong Connect the tiles lie flat, and you can match two if a line with no more than two turns can join them.

faq.q: Is this the same as the Chinese mahjong game?
faq.a: Not quite. The traditional game is usually played by four people with tiles, while mahjong solitaire is a one-player matching puzzle that uses the same tile pictures.

faq.q: What should I do when there are no more matches?
faq.a: Use a hint or shuffle if the game offers one, or restart. Next time, try to clear the tallest stacks first so fewer tiles stay blocked.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. Every mahjong game on Pixuvo is free to play in the browser.

match-3.intro:
Swap two candies, line up three, and pop! Match 3 games are easy to understand in seconds, yet they keep getting more interesting with every level. Pixuvo has more than 2,300 of them.

The rule is the same everywhere: swap neighboring pieces to make a row of three or more of the same kind. Match four or five and you usually get special pieces that clear whole rows or blow up an area. Candy and shiny jewels are the classic themes, but you will also find ocean, food and other settings, and some games mix the formula with something new, like merging or decorating. A quick way in: Candy Match Saga 2, Sweet Blast, Super Candy Jewels, Gemcrafter and Ocean Crash.

Starting out? Look for matches near the bottom of the board first, because the pieces that fall down can create extra combos by themselves. Save special pieces for when you really need them. Match 3 games are perfect for short breaks and work great with a mouse or a finger, so many are a good fit for tablets and phones – whether a game runs on mobile is listed on its page.

faq.q: What is a match 3 game?
faq.a: It is a puzzle game where you swap pieces to line up three or more of the same kind. Matched pieces disappear, new ones fall in, and you try to reach each level's goal.

faq.q: How do you make special pieces in match 3 games?
faq.a: In most games, matching four or five pieces at once creates a special piece that can clear a row, a column or a whole area.

faq.q: Are there candy-themed match 3 games?
