faq.a: Yes, candy is one of the classic match 3 themes, and this category has lots of sweet-looking boards. Candy Match Saga 2 and Sweet Blast are two to try.

faq.q: Why should I match at the bottom first?
faq.a: Matches at the bottom make everything above them fall, which often creates free bonus matches. Matches at the top only move a few pieces.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. All match 3 games on Pixuvo are free to play, with no sign-up.

math.intro:
Who says math has to be worksheets? In math games, the right answer makes something happen: a fighter lands a punch, a monster gets fed, a race car speeds ahead. Pixuvo has more than 700 free math games that turn numbers into a challenge kids actually want to play.

The games cover lots of skills. Arithmetic games practice adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing. Battle-style games turn sums into a duel, where quick mental math gives you the edge. Number puzzles such as 2048 are less about speed and more about logic. Kobadoo Arithmetic, Kids Math Online, Math Fight Club, Math Battle and Number Sums are a few to try. Many games let you pick the type of problem or the difficulty, which makes them useful for younger and older kids alike.

For the best results, choose a game that matches what you are learning right now – a first-grader adding small numbers needs something different from a sixth-grader working on times tables. Short, regular sessions of ten minutes help more than one long one. Parents and teachers can sit next to kids and turn it into a friendly competition. Most math games are played with a mouse, keyboard or a tap on the answer. Playing on a tablet? Many games support it, and the game page shows which ones. More brain games live in the puzzle category.

faq.q: Do math games really help kids learn?
faq.a: Math games give lots of quick practice and instant feedback, which helps facts like times tables stick. They work best alongside schoolwork, in short regular sessions.

faq.q: What are good math games for practicing times tables?
faq.a: Look for games that let you choose multiplication and start slowly before you speed up. Math Fight Club, Math Battle and Kobadoo Arithmetic are easy places to start.

faq.q: Are there math games for younger kids?
faq.a: Yes, many math games start with simple adding and counting, and many let you choose the difficulty. Kids Math Online and Kobadoo Arithmetic are two to try.

faq.q: What math skills can kids practice here?
faq.a: Addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, number logic and mental math speed. Number puzzles such as 2048 also train number sense.

faq.q: Can kids play math games on a tablet?
faq.a: Many math games are tap-to-answer, so they work well on phones and tablets. Whether a game runs on mobile is listed on its page.

maze.intro:
Left, right, dead end, back again – and then suddenly the exit is right in front of you. Maze games are one of the oldest puzzles in the world, and they are still great fun on a screen. Pixuvo has more than 190 free maze games to solve in your browser.

Not every maze is drawn on paper. Some are classic top-down labyrinths where you guide a character to the exit. Others are ball-rolling puzzles, where you steer a ball through tricky paths and try not to drop it into holes, and some add their own path-finding twists. Right now Maze Escape Hero, Maze Evolution HTML, MarbleMaze2, Roll Ball: Hole Puzzle, Maze Control HD and Snake Way sit near the top of the list.

A trick explorers have used for a long time: keep one hand on the wall. If you always follow the same wall, left or right, you will eventually reach the exit of a simple maze. Another tip is to look at the maze from the exit backward before you move. Maze games are great for younger children because they practice planning and spatial thinking without being stressful. You usually move with the arrow keys or by dragging with the mouse or a finger. On a phone or tablet? Many games run there too; look for it on the game page. More logic games are waiting in the puzzle category.

faq.q: What is the trick to solving a maze?
faq.a: In many simple mazes you can follow one wall all the time, always keeping it on the same side, until you reach the exit. Planning from the exit backward also helps.

faq.q: Are maze games good for kids?
faq.a: Yes, they practice planning, patience and spatial thinking. Small, simple mazes are a gentle start for younger kids.

faq.q: What is a marble maze game?
faq.a: In a marble maze you roll a ball through the paths and try not to drop it into holes. A quick way in: MarbleMaze2 and Roll Ball: Hole Puzzle.

faq.q: How do you control maze games?
faq.a: Most use the arrow keys, the mouse or dragging with a finger. The game page lists the controls for each game.

faq.q: Are maze games free on Pixuvo?
faq.a: Yes, every maze game on Pixuvo is free and runs in your browser with no sign-up.

memory.intro:
Flip a card, remember what it was, flip another… was the matching one in the corner or in the middle? Memory games are simple to start and a real workout for your brain. Pixuvo has more than 600 free memory games to play in your browser.

The classic is the card-matching game: all cards lie face down and you turn two at a time to find pairs. Sequence games test a different kind of memory – you watch a pattern of colors or sounds and repeat it, and the pattern gets longer each round. Other games train memory for numbers and positions, and spot-the-difference games mix memory with careful looking. Good ones to start with: Memory Cards, Funny Animals Memory Game, Flag Memory Match, Kobadoo Numbers, Three Cups Game and The Kitchen - Spot the differences.

To get better, try saying what you see quietly in your head ("cat, top left") – words help pictures stick. Start with fewer cards and add more as you improve. Memory games are great for all ages and a fun choice for parents and kids to play in turns. They need only a mouse or a tap, and plenty of them work on phones and tablets as well – the game page says so. More thinking games are in the puzzle category.

faq.q: Do memory games improve memory?
faq.a: They give your working memory regular practice, especially when the games get harder step by step. Playing short sessions often works better than one long session.

faq.q: What are good memory games for kids?
faq.a: Card-matching games are easy to learn, and sequence games are a fun step up. Try Funny Animals Memory Game, Memory Cards or Flag Memory Match first.

faq.q: How do you win a memory card game?
faq.a: Remember the position of every card you flip, even if it was not a match. Naming cards in your head, like "dog, second row", makes them easier to recall.

faq.q: Can parents and kids play memory games together?
faq.a: Yes, card-matching games are easy to play in turns on the same screen. They are a nice way to share a few minutes of play.

faq.q: Are memory games free?
faq.a: Yes, all memory games on Pixuvo are free in the browser with no sign-up.

motorcycle.intro:
Two wheels, one rider and a ramp that looks way too high – motorcycle games are a mix of speed, balance and daring stunts. Pixuvo has more than 700 free motorcycle games, from dirt-bike courses to highway racing.

A favorite style is the stunt bike game, where each level is an obstacle course full of jumps, loops and traps. You lean forward and back to keep your rider balanced, and landing on two wheels is the whole challenge. Moto X3M: Spooky Land is a good example. Motocross games take you onto muddy dirt tracks, road racers are all about speed on asphalt, and if you prefer pedaling, BMX and mountain bike games bring bicycles into the mix. Stunt Extreme, Impossible Bike Stunt Ride, Motocross Racing, Real Motor Race Master and BMX Kid are more games to try.

For stunt games, the most important tip is balance: lean back to lift the front wheel on jumps, lean forward to stop yourself from flipping, and try to land with both wheels at once. Many stunt levels are short, so retrying is quick. Most use the arrow keys, sometimes with extra keys to lean. Playing on a tablet? Many games support it, and the game page shows which ones. Motorcycle games are part of the bigger racing category.

faq.q: What are the best motorcycle games for kids?
faq.a: Moto X3M: Spooky Land is a good one to start with if you like stunt courses, and Motocross Racing, Stunt Extreme and BMX Kid are more to try.

faq.q: How do you keep your balance in bike stunt games?
faq.a: Lean back when you take off from a ramp and lean forward if the bike starts to flip backward. Try to land on both wheels at the same time.

faq.q: What is the difference between motocross and road racing games?
faq.a: Motocross games happen on bumpy dirt tracks with jumps, while road racing games are about top speed on asphalt, often through traffic.

faq.q: What controls do motorcycle games use?
faq.a: Usually the arrow keys to speed up, brake and lean. The game page lists the controls for each game.

faq.q: Can I play motorcycle games on a tablet?
faq.a: Many motorcycle games have touch buttons and work on phones and tablets. The game page tells you whether it works on phones and tablets.

multiplayer.intro:
Games are often more fun with other people, and that is what this section is all about. Multiplayer is not a genre but a way to play: you share the game with friends, family or other players online. Pixuvo has more than 800 multiplayer games.

There are two main ways to play. Local multiplayer means everyone plays on the same device – often one keyboard, with one player on WASD and the other on the arrow keys. Online multiplayer connects you with other players over the internet. Games listed near the top include Bunny Boy Online, MultiPlayer Pong, Tanknarok, Obby Football Soccer 3D and Mage Royale. You will find all sorts of game types here, from team battles and bomber games to sports and action games. Some shooter-style games are aimed at older kids.

For a family game night, local games on one screen are the easiest: no setup, just sit together and play. For online games, it is a good idea for parents to check how a game works first and to remind kids never to share personal information with other players. The game page says whether a game is local or online when the publisher provides it, and our parents page has more tips.

faq.q: What are the best multiplayer games to play with friends?
faq.a: Good ones to start with include MultiPlayer Pong, Tanknarok, Obby Football Soccer 3D and Mage Royale. The game page shows whether a game is played on one device or online.

faq.q: What is the difference between local and online multiplayer?
faq.a: Local multiplayer means everyone plays on the same device, often sharing one keyboard. Online multiplayer connects you with other players over the internet.

faq.q: Can we play multiplayer games on one computer?
faq.a: Yes, many games let two players share one keyboard, usually WASD for one player and the arrow keys for the other. Our 2 player section has even more of these.

faq.q: Are online multiplayer games safe for kids?
faq.a: Parents should check a game before kids play online and remind them never to share personal information. Our parents page explains more about safety on Pixuvo.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. All multiplayer games on Pixuvo are free to play in the browser, without creating an account.

music.intro:
Tap to the beat, jump on the rhythm, or build your own song. Music games are for everyone who cannot keep their feet still when a good tune comes on. Pixuvo has almost 200 of them.

Rhythm games are a big group. You press keys or tap at the right moment as notes fly by, and in some games your character hops along with the beat. Friday Night Funkin'-style games, often called FNF, are a well-known kind where you win music battles by hitting arrows in time. Creative games let you make your own sounds by combining beats, voices and instruments into a song, and some help you explore real instruments. A quick way in: Tile Jumper 3D, FNF - House, Beat Maker Pro, Robot Band, Musical Instruments and Singing Blob.

Turn the sound on – music games need it! Headphones help if others are around. For rhythm games, start at an easy speed and focus on the beat, not the screen. Keyboard rhythm games feel best on a computer, while tap-based music games work well on tablets and phones; you can see on the game page whether a phone or tablet will work.

faq.q: What are rhythm games?
faq.a: Rhythm games ask you to press keys or tap the screen in time with the music. The better your timing, the higher your score.

faq.q: What is FNF?
faq.a: FNF stands for Friday Night Funkin', a rhythm game where you win music battles by pressing arrow keys in time with the song. There are many fan-made games in this style.

faq.q: Can I make my own music in these games?
faq.a: Yes, beat-maker games let you mix beats, voices and instruments into your own little song. Beat Maker Pro is a good one to start with.

faq.q: Do I need sound to play music games?
faq.a: Yes, most music games are much easier and more fun with sound on. Headphones are a good idea if others are nearby.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. All music games on Pixuvo are free to play in the browser.

ninja.intro:
Silent steps on a rooftop, a quick leap over a gap, a shuriken flying through the air – ninja games turn you into a fast, sneaky hero. Pixuvo has more than 250 free ninja games that run straight in your browser.

The idea behind most of them is agility. Instead of standing in one place and fighting, you jump, dash and wall-climb through levels, and timing matters more than strength. Some games are side-scrolling platformers where you run across roofs, and others are survival games where the goal is to stay alive as long as you can. If you enjoy swords and story, samurai-style adventures are here too, though some have a darker look and suit older kids best. A quick way in: Rooftop Ninja, Ninja Survival, Samurai. Shoguns Betrayal and Ashen Ninja - Rust and Katana.

New ninjas should start with a platformer, because you learn jump timing first and fighting later. Most ninja games use the arrow keys or WASD to move and one key to jump or throw, and the controls are listed on the game page. Plenty of them work on phones and tablets as well – the game page says so. When you want bigger battles, the fighting games category is close by, and the full action category has thousands more games built on fast reflexes.

faq.q: What are ninja games?
faq.a: Ninja games are action games where you play a quick, stealthy hero who jumps, climbs, sneaks and uses weapons like shuriken or a katana. Agility and timing matter more than strength.

faq.q: Which ninja game should I try first?
faq.a: Start with a platformer and get used to the jump timing – Rooftop Ninja is a nice easy one, and Ninja Survival is another to try.

faq.q: What is the difference between ninja and samurai games?
faq.a: Ninja games usually focus on speed, sneaking and acrobatics, while samurai games are more about sword duels and honor-themed stories. Pixuvo lists both kinds here.

faq.q: Are ninja games suitable for younger kids?
faq.a: Many ninja platformers are cartoon-style and easy to enjoy, but some samurai adventures have a darker look. Parents can read our parents page to see how games are reviewed.

faq.q: Can I play ninja games on a tablet?
faq.a: Many games also work on phones and tablets. Check the game page – it shows whether a game supports touch screens.

parking.intro:
Reverse a little, turn the wheel, check the mirror… and slide perfectly between the lines. Parking games turn one of the trickiest parts of driving into a puzzle you can win. Pixuvo has more than 550 free parking games to play in the browser.

There are two very different kinds. Driving-style parking games let you steer the car yourself and park it in a marked space without hitting walls or other cars. Puzzle-style parking games show you a crowded lot from above, and you must figure out in which order to move the cars so everyone can get out. Parking Jam 3D, Parkings Jaam, Unblock Car Parking, Car Parking 12, Underground Parking and Ultimate Car Parking Challenge are a few games listed near the top, and the game description tells you which kind each one is.

If you like steering, start with an early level of a driving-style game and go slowly – speed is the enemy of good parking. Use small movements, stop often and use the camera view if the game has one. If you prefer logic, puzzle parking games are great because there is no time pressure in many levels and you can plan every move. Driving parking games use the arrow keys or WASD, while puzzle ones need only a click or tap. Playing on a tablet? Many games support it, and the game page shows which ones. Parking games are part of the driving category.

faq.q: What is a parking jam game?
faq.a: It is a puzzle where cars are packed into a parking lot and you choose the order to drive them out without crashing. The game description tells you whether a parking game is this kind of puzzle.

faq.q: How do you get better at parking games?
faq.a: Drive slowly, use small steering movements and stop to check your angle. Switching to a top-down camera, if the game has one, makes tight spots much easier.

faq.q: Which parking game is good for beginners?
faq.a: Puzzle-style parking jams are easy to start, because you just tap the cars. If you want to steer yourself, take the first levels slowly.

faq.q: Can I play parking games on my phone?
faq.a: Puzzle parking games need only taps, and many driving parking games have touch controls, so lots of them work on phones and tablets. The game page shows if mobile is supported.

faq.q: Are parking games free?
faq.a: Yes, all parking games on Pixuvo are free to play in the browser with no account.

platformer.intro:
Run, jump, miss the ledge, try again – and finally make it. That feeling is the heart of platformer games, one of the oldest and most loved game styles. Pixuvo has more than 1,700 platformers, from gentle adventures to tough challenges.

Classic adventure platformers send you through levels full of gaps, enemies and coins. Puzzle platformers make you think before you jump, with levels that hide a trick. Then there are hard platformers, made for players who love a real challenge and do not mind falling a lot. Try Super Willie World, Super Onion Boy 2, Red Ball Rolling 2, The Floor Is Lying, The Black And White or Snail Odyssey - Hardest Game.

New players should start with an adventure platformer where levels are short and checkpoints are close. Learn the jump: most games let you jump higher by holding the button longer. On a computer you usually move with the arrow keys or WASD and jump with the up arrow, W or space. Some platformers have on-screen buttons for phones and tablets, but many feel best with a keyboard – each game page shows if touch screens are supported.

faq.q: What is a platformer game?
faq.a: A platformer is a game where you run and jump between platforms, avoiding gaps, traps and enemies to reach the end of each level.

faq.q: What are good platformer games for beginners?
faq.a: Look for platformers with short levels and close checkpoints, and save the hardest ones for later. You could start with Super Willie World, Super Onion Boy 2 and Red Ball Rolling 2.

faq.q: What keys do you use in platformer games?
faq.a: Most use the arrow keys or WASD to move, and the up arrow, W or space to jump. The controls are usually shown on the game's start screen.

faq.q: Can I play platformers on a phone?
faq.a: Some platformers have touch buttons and work on phones and tablets, but many are easiest with a keyboard. Whether a game runs on mobile is listed on its page.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. Every platformer on Pixuvo is free and opens instantly in your browser.

pool.intro:
Chalk the cue, line up the shot, and think one ball ahead. Pool and billiards games are calm, clever and a little bit like geometry homework that is actually fun. Pixuvo has more than 360 of them.

The best-known version is 8-ball pool: one player takes the solid balls, the other the stripes, and whoever pockets all of theirs and then the black 8-ball wins. Try 8-Ball Pool Pro, PoolClub or Billiard King for classic tables. There are other styles too. Three-cushion billiards is played on a table without pockets, where the cue ball has to touch three cushions, and Russian pyramid uses big balls and tight pockets – 3 Cushion Billards and Billiards 3D Russian Pyramid are two to try. Simply Billiards, Pooking Master and 8 Ball Pool Free are more good tables to try.

If you are just starting, pick a game that shows an aiming line. It helps you see how the ball will bounce off the cushions. Then practice soft shots – hitting too hard is the most common mistake. On a computer you aim with the mouse; on a tablet or phone you drag with your finger. Many pool games support touch screens, and the game page tells you which ones do.

faq.q: What is the difference between pool and billiards?
faq.a: Billiards is the family name for cue sports, and pool is one popular type of it, played on a table with six pockets. Some billiards games, like 3-cushion billiards, have no pockets at all.

faq.q: How do you play 8-ball pool?
faq.a: One player gets the solid balls and the other the stripes. You pocket all of your group and then the black 8-ball to win, but sinking the 8-ball too early loses the game.

faq.q: Can I play pool against a friend?
faq.a: Yes, many pool games let two players take turns on the same device, and some offer online matches. The game page shows which modes a game has.

faq.q: Why does my cue ball keep going into the pocket?
faq.a: You are probably hitting too hard. Use less power and watch the aiming line to see where the cue ball will roll after it hits.

faq.q: Do pool games work on phones?
faq.a: Many pool games use drag-to-aim controls that work well on phones and tablets. The game page tells you whether it works on phones and tablets.

puzzle.intro:
Some games test your fingers; puzzle games test your brain. Fitting blocks into place, spotting the pattern, finding the shortest path – there is a special kind of joy in the moment a tricky level suddenly makes sense. Pixuvo has more than 15,000 free puzzle games, the biggest category on the site.

Because it is so big, the puzzle section is split into smaller groups. Jigsaw games let you put pictures back together; 2048 games are about sliding and merging number tiles; hidden object games ask you to search a busy scene; block puzzles have you fit and clear shapes; maze games challenge you to find the way through; math games turn sums into a race; and memory games train you to remember and match. Games listed near the top include Drop Planets, Merge Royal, Seat the Guests, Memory Cards, Flag Memory Match, Kobadoo Arithmetic and Math Fight Club.

If you are new to puzzles, begin with games that have short levels and get harder slowly, like a memory match or an easy jigsaw. Older kids who love a challenge can try logic and merge games, which reward thinking several moves ahead. Most puzzles need only a mouse or a tap, so they are comfortable on any device. Playing on a tablet? Many games support it, and the game page shows which ones.

faq.q: Are puzzle games good for your brain?
faq.a: Puzzle games make you plan, spot patterns, remember and try again after mistakes, which is great practice for thinking skills. They are also a calm way to spend screen time.

faq.q: What are good puzzle games for beginners?
faq.a: Memory matching games like Memory Cards, easy jigsaws and gentle merge games are a great start. They have short levels that get harder slowly.

faq.q: What kinds of puzzle games are there?
faq.a: Pixuvo groups them into jigsaw, 2048, hidden object, block, maze, math and memory games, plus many logic puzzles that do not fit one box.

faq.q: Where can I play puzzle games for free?
faq.a: Right here on Pixuvo – more than 15,000 puzzle games run free in your browser with no download or sign-up.

faq.q: Can I play puzzle games on a phone or tablet?
faq.a: Most puzzles need only taps, so many work well on phones and tablets. Check the game page to see if it runs on your device.

quiz.intro:
How many flags can you name? Do you know your shapes, colors and emojis? Quiz games turn your knowledge into a challenge, and with more than 330 of them on Pixuvo, there is always something new to test yourself on.

Some quizzes are about learning facts like flags, shapes or emojis, and trivia games mix questions from many topics. Other quizzes test your eyes and attention instead of facts, and some add a word-puzzle twist. The Kobadoo series is a good place to start – Kobadoo Flags, Kobadoo Shapes and Kobadoo Emojis are all listed near the top – and Fight Trivia, WhatQuiz, How Many Mice and CrossWord are more to try.

Quiz games are fun alone, but even better with family. Take turns answering, or race to shout the answer before the timer runs out. If a topic is new to you, do not worry about getting things wrong – that is how you learn. Most quiz games need only clicks or taps, so they work well on computers, tablets and many phones; each game page shows if touch screens are supported.

faq.q: What are good quiz games for kids?
faq.a: To get going, try the Kobadoo games, like Kobadoo Flags and Kobadoo Shapes. Older kids might also try Fight Trivia or WhatQuiz.

faq.q: Is there a flag quiz?
faq.a: Yes – Kobadoo Flags is one to try. Flag quizzes are a fun way to learn geography.

faq.q: Can we play quiz games as a family?
faq.a: Yes! Take turns answering or play as a team on one screen. Quiz games are a great way to learn new facts together.

faq.q: Do quiz games help kids learn?
faq.a: Quizzes are a fun way to practice facts and remember them better. Getting answers wrong is part of the learning.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. All quiz games on Pixuvo are free to play in your browser, with no account.

racing.intro:
Three, two, one – go! Racing games are about the thrill of speed and the joy of crossing the finish line first. Pixuvo has more than 5,000 free racing games, so whether you want to race cars, ride a dirt bike or smash into other drivers, there is a track waiting for you.

The category splits into a few lanes. Car games cover everything from city cars to supercars and karts. Drift games are about sliding sideways through corners in style. Motorcycle games bring ramps, flips and balance – Moto X3M: Spooky Land and Motocross Racing are good first rides. Beyond those, you will find chase games, demolition derbies and quick races – Endless Car Chase, Demolition Derby Life, BMG! CrashDay 2025 and Mini Car Racing are a few to try.

Which race should you try first? If you are new, choose a game with short tracks or levels, so you can learn the controls before longer races. Stunt bike games are great if you like puzzles too, because every jump has to be timed just right. On a computer most racers use the arrow keys or WASD, and some 2 player games split the keyboard between two drivers. Plenty of them work on phones and tablets as well – the game page says so. Looking for slower, more careful steering? The driving category has parking, truck and bus games.

faq.q: What are the best racing games for kids?
faq.a: Moto X3M: Spooky Land, Motocross Racing and Mini Car Racing make a good first lap. If you are new, look for games with short levels and simple controls.

faq.q: Can racing games improve your driving?
faq.a: Racing games can train reaction time and hand-eye coordination, but they are not the same as real driving and do not teach road rules. They are for fun, not driving lessons.

faq.q: Are there racing games for two players on one computer?
faq.a: Yes, some racing games let two players share a keyboard, one with WASD and the other with the arrow keys. The game page shows when two players are supported.

faq.q: What is the difference between racing and driving games?
faq.a: Racing games are about speed and winning against the clock or other racers. Driving games focus on careful steering, like parking a car or delivering cargo with a truck.

faq.q: Can I play racing games on my phone?
faq.a: Many racing games have on-screen buttons or tilt controls and work on phones and tablets. You can see on the game page whether a phone or tablet will work.

retro.intro:
Chunky pixels, beeping sound effects and simple rules that are surprisingly hard to master – retro games bring back the style of early home computers and arcade cabinets. Pixuvo has more than 550 free retro games, playable in your browser with no emulator and nothing to install.

Retro does not mean old and boring. Many of these games are brand-new creations that borrow ideas from the classic era. You will find space games, adventures, dungeon crawls and even pinball, and many of them show how much fun one simple idea can be. Good ones to start with: Pixeroids, Star Wing, Shadoworld Adventure, Jungle Game, Dunjun, 3D Pinball - Space Cadet and Boing Bang.

For a first try, pick something with a single goal you understand in ten seconds, like dodging asteroids or bouncing a ball. Retro games are great for parents and kids to play together, because grown-ups often recognize the style and can share a few tricks. Most use only the arrow keys and one or two buttons, which makes them easy on a keyboard. Plenty of them work on phones and tablets as well – the game page says so. Retro games are part of the arcade category, so more score-chasing classics are just one click away.

faq.q: What are retro games?
faq.a: Retro games use the look and ideas of older video games – pixel art, simple sounds and clear arcade-style rules. Some are remakes, while many are new games made in the old style.

faq.q: Can I play retro games in my browser without an emulator?
faq.a: Yes. Retro games on Pixuvo run directly in the web browser, so there is nothing to download or install.

faq.q: Is there a pinball game on Pixuvo?
faq.a: Yes, 3D Pinball - Space Cadet is listed in the retro category and plays right in the browser.

faq.q: Are retro games good for playing with parents?
faq.a: Very much so. Many parents remember this style of game, and the simple controls make it easy to take turns and compare scores.

faq.q: What controls do retro games use?
faq.a: Most use the arrow keys plus one or two buttons, like the space bar. The game page lists the exact controls.

runner.intro:
Run, jump, slide, repeat – and do not hit the wall. Runner games keep you moving forward while the world rushes toward you, and every second you survive adds to your distance or score. Pixuvo has more than 2,000 free runner games to play in the browser.

There are a few kinds worth knowing. Endless runners never finish: the track goes on and the speed creeps up until you make a mistake, so the challenge is beating your own best run. Level runners have a finish line, and often a twist on the way, like gates that change your crowd or items to collect. Lane runners let you switch between a few lanes to dodge trains, barriers and gaps. Then there are odd and funny ones with unusual heroes. A quick way in: Popcorn Race 3D, Spider Evolution Runner Game, Subway Princess Run, 3D laane runner and Runner Soldiers.

Runner games are easy to start because they usually need just a few keys: arrows to switch lanes, up to jump, down to slide, or a single tap or swipe on a touch screen. Lots of these games work on a phone or tablet too; check the game page to be sure. A tip from experienced runners: look further ahead than the next obstacle, so you have time to react. Runners are part of the arcade category, where you can find more quick score-chasing games.

faq.q: What is an endless runner game?
faq.a: An endless runner is a game where your character keeps running automatically and the track never ends. You dodge obstacles as the speed increases and try to beat your best distance.

faq.q: What are the best runner games to start with?
faq.a: Popcorn Race 3D, Subway Princess Run and 3D laane runner are good ones to try. Most runners are easy to learn in the first minute.

faq.q: How do you get better at runner games?
faq.a: Look ahead instead of at your character, so you see obstacles earlier. Stay calm when the speed rises and make small, early moves rather than last-second jumps.

faq.q: Can I play runner games with swipes on my phone?
faq.a: Many runner games support swipes and taps, and lots of them work on phones and tablets. The game page shows if a game runs on mobile.

faq.q: Are runner games free?
faq.a: Yes, all runner games on Pixuvo are free to play in the browser without signing up.

shooting.intro:
Steady hands, a sharp eye and good timing – shooting games are, at heart, all about aim. Pixuvo has more than 4,000 free shooting games, from target practice and space shooters to big team battles, all running in the browser.

Shooting games are often called "shooters," and they come in several styles. Sniper games are about patience and one perfect long-range shot. Zombie games are about surviving waves of slow-moving undead. First-person shooters show the action through your hero's eyes, as in Commando Force 2, Strykon and Battle Shot Elite. Tank games swap soldiers for armored vehicles and big cannons, and archery games bring bows and arrows. Outside those groups, there are flying shooters, stickman battles and more – Fractal Combat X, Stickman Prison Counter Assault, Trap the Convoy and Quarantine Zombies are worth a try.

If you want to get better, focus on two things: aim before you shoot, and keep moving so you are harder to hit. Many shooters let you adjust mouse sensitivity, and lowering it often makes aiming steadier. On a computer, most use WASD to move and the mouse to aim and fire. Playing on a tablet? Many games support it, and the game page shows which ones. Some shooters are realistic and better for older kids; games with violent wording are held for manual review, and our parents page explains how we check games, so families can choose what fits them.

faq.q: What are shooting games called?
faq.a: They are usually called shooters. Common types include first-person shooters (FPS), third-person shooters, top-down shooters, shoot 'em ups and sniper games.

faq.q: How do you get better at shooting games?
faq.a: Take a moment to aim before firing, keep moving so you are harder to hit, and try a lower mouse sensitivity for steadier aim. Short practice sessions help too.

faq.q: What does ADS mean in shooting games?
faq.a: ADS means "aim down sights": you look through the gun's sight to aim more precisely, usually by holding the right mouse button.

faq.q: Are shooting games OK for kids?
faq.a: It depends on the game and the family. Many browser shooters are cartoon-style, while others are more realistic; games with violent wording are reviewed manually, and our parents page explains how.

faq.q: Can I play shooting games on a phone?
faq.a: Some shooters have touch controls and work on phones and tablets, but many play best with a mouse and keyboard. The game page tells you whether it works on phones and tablets.

simulation.intro:
Ever wanted to drive a bus, run a supermarket or design your own roads? Simulation games let you try jobs and worlds you cannot try in real life. With more than 3,100 of them, there is a lot to explore.

Simulations come in many flavors. Tycoon games put you in charge of a business that grows step by step. Farming games are about planting, harvesting and caring for animals, and building games let you construct anything from roads to rockets. Then there are job and driving simulators, and sandbox games where you set up the scene and watch what happens. Garden Master, Road Designer, Stack Rocket, Bus Driver Simulator 3D and Supermarket Simulator Dream Store are a few to try.

Not sure where to begin? Ask yourself what you would like to be for a day. A shop owner? Try a store or tycoon game. A farmer? Head to farming. A builder? Try the building games. Simulation games are often longer than arcade games, and many save your progress in the browser on the device you play on. Bigger 3D simulators run best on a computer, while lighter ones also work on phones and tablets – the game page shows which.

faq.q: What are simulation games?
faq.a: Simulation games copy something from real life, like driving, running a shop or farming, and let you try it yourself. Some are realistic, others are playful and silly.

faq.q: What kinds of simulation games are there?
faq.a: On Pixuvo you will find tycoon, farming and building games, plus driving, job and sandbox simulators. Each main type has its own section.

faq.q: Does my progress get saved in simulation games?
faq.a: Many simulation games save progress in your browser on the same device, but it depends on the game. If you clear your browser data or switch devices, the progress may be gone.

faq.q: Can I play simulation games on a phone?
faq.a: Lighter simulation games often work on phones and tablets, while big 3D simulators run best on a computer. Each game page shows if touch screens are supported.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. Every simulation game on Pixuvo is free and runs in the browser without downloading.

snake.intro:
Eat, grow, and whatever you do, do not bite your own tail. Snake is one of the simplest game ideas ever made, and that is exactly why it is still so popular. Pixuvo has more than 250 free snake games, from the classic grid version to big online arenas full of other players' worms.

The classic style is all about planning: your snake moves on its own, you only steer, and every snack makes you longer, so the board fills up and you have to leave yourself an escape route. The .io style is different. You slither around a large arena with other snakes, and if their head touches your body, they are out – so being big is good, but being clever is better. Worms Zone, Gusano.io Worms Snake Game, Color Snake 3D Online, Snake Arena 2 and Snake Frenzy Color Clash are good ones to try.

Beginners should start slow: stay near the edges early on, make wide turns and avoid crowds in arena games until you have grown. On a computer you steer with the arrow keys or the mouse; on touch screens you usually swipe or drag. Lots of these games work on a phone or tablet too; check the game page to be sure. Snake games belong to the arcade category, where more quick high-score games are waiting.

faq.q: How do you play snake games?
faq.a: You steer a snake that keeps moving, eat food to grow longer and avoid crashing into walls or your own tail. In arena versions you also avoid other players' snakes.

faq.q: What is an .io snake game?
faq.a: It is a snake game in a big shared arena, often online with other players. Worms Zone and Gusano.io Worms Snake Game are two to try.

faq.q: What is a good snake game strategy?
faq.a: Make wide turns, leave yourself an open path and do not chase food into tight spaces. In arena games, grow carefully before you try to trap others.

faq.q: Can I play snake games on my phone?
faq.a: Many snake games use swipes or dragging, so they work well on touch screens. The game page shows if mobile is supported.

faq.q: What is snakes and ladders?
faq.a: Snakes and ladders is a classic board game where you roll a die, climb up ladders and slide down snakes. Snake n Ladders Game is listed in this category, and its game page explains how it plays.

sniper.intro:
Breathe in, line up the crosshair, wait for the right moment… and take the shot. Sniper games are the patient side of shooting: instead of running and gunning, you look through a scope and make one precise long-range shot count. Pixuvo has more than 150 free sniper games in the browser.

Most sniper games give you a mission and a scene to scan. You zoom in through the scope, find the right target and fire before you are spotted or before time runs out. Some add a puzzle element, where finding the right target is part of the challenge, and others take you to places like the Wild West or outer space. Good ones to start with: Courageous Sniper, Ghost Sniper, Sniper Shot, West Frontier Sharpshooter 3D and Sniper Wars Find the Criminal.

The secret to good sniping is patience. Watch where targets move before you shoot, and in games with wind or distance, aim slightly ahead or above. Scanning the whole scene first often shows you the best angle. Sniper games use the mouse to aim and zoom on a computer, which is why they play best with a mouse. Playing on a tablet? Many games support it, and the game page shows which ones. Some sniper games are realistic and suit older kids better; parents can read our parents page to see how games are reviewed. Sniper games are part of the shooting category.

faq.q: What are sniper games?
faq.a: Sniper games are shooting games about long-range precision. You aim through a scope, pick the right target and make each shot count.

faq.q: How do you aim better in sniper games?
faq.a: Take your time, watch how targets move and fire when they slow down. In games with wind or distance, aim slightly ahead or above the target.

faq.q: Are there sniper games without realistic violence?
faq.a: Some sniper games use cartoon targets, aliens or puzzles instead of realistic scenes, and the game description usually gives you an idea. Parents can check our parents page for how we review games.

faq.q: Do sniper games work on tablets?
faq.a: Some do, but sniper games usually play best with a mouse for precise aiming. You can see on the game page whether a phone or tablet will work.

faq.q: Are sniper games free on Pixuvo?
faq.a: Yes, every sniper game on Pixuvo is free to play in your browser with no download.

solitaire.intro:
Just you, a deck of cards and a quiet few minutes. Solitaire, also called patience, is one of the classic computer card games, and Pixuvo has more than 120 versions of it.

Klondike is the classic most people picture: seven columns of cards, building down in alternating colors and moving aces to the top to sort each suit. Klondike Solitaire 4 Suits and Klondike Kings Solitaire are two to try. Spider Solitaire uses two decks and asks you to build full runs from king to ace, and TriPeaks is faster: you clear three pyramids of cards by picking cards one higher or lower than the open card. Ultimate Solitaire Classic, Spider Solitaire Classic Ver, Tripeaks Solitaire Classic and Solitaire Holiday are more games listed near the top.

Beginners should start with Klondike using one-card draw, which is easier to win. A useful tip: always try to uncover face-down cards first, and do not rush to empty a column unless you have a king ready. Solitaire works with clicks, drags or taps, and many versions run well on tablets and phones – check the game page to see if it runs on your device.

faq.q: How do you play Klondike solitaire?
faq.a: Build down the seven columns in alternating colors, like a red 6 on a black 7, and move cards to the four foundation piles from ace to king. You win when every card is sorted by suit.

faq.q: What is the difference between Klondike, Spider and TriPeaks?
faq.a: Klondike uses one deck and alternating colors, Spider uses two decks and full king-to-ace runs, and TriPeaks is about clearing card pyramids one step higher or lower. TriPeaks is the quickest to learn.

faq.q: Is every solitaire game winnable?
faq.a: No, some deals cannot be solved, even by the best players. If you get stuck, start a new game – that is part of solitaire.

faq.q: Can I play solitaire on my phone?
faq.a: Many solitaire games support taps and drags and work well on phones and tablets. Each game page shows if touch screens are supported.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. All solitaire games on Pixuvo are free, with no sign-up and no download.

sports.intro:
No stadium tickets needed: the scoreboard is right in your browser. Pixuvo has more than 2,300 sports games, and they are great for short breaks because one match, one penalty or one round usually takes just a few minutes.

The biggest groups have their own pages. Football games (soccer) cover penalties, free kicks and quick matches. Basketball games are about shooting hoops and dunking. Pool and billiards games test your angles, and golf games range from relaxing mini golf to long drives. You will also find parkour-style stunts and plenty of funny physics sports that do not exist in real life.

Games listed near the top include Curve Kick, Swipy Basketball, Golf Orbit, Billiards on Ice and Ragdoll Mega Dunk. How to choose? If you want something quick, try a one-button shooting game like a penalty or hoop challenge. If you like playing against someone, look for games that say "2 player" – many let two people share one keyboard. Most sports games use the mouse or simple swipes, so they are easy to try on a tablet or phone too; the game page shows which ones work on mobile.

faq.q: What are the best sports games for kids?
faq.a: Short, simple games are a great start: Curve Kick and Penalty Kick Wiz for football, Swipy Basketball for hoops and Golf Orbit for golf. They teach the timing and aiming that harder sports games build on.

faq.q: Which sports can I play here?
faq.a: Football (soccer), basketball, pool and billiards, and golf have their own sections, and there are many other sports and stunt games mixed in the main list.

faq.q: Can two players play sports games on one computer?
faq.a: Yes, many sports games have a two-player mode where one person uses WASD and the other the arrow keys. The game page tells you when a game supports two players.

faq.q: Can I play sports games on my phone?
faq.a: Many sports games use swipes or taps and work well on phones and tablets. The game page tells you whether it works on phones and tablets.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. All sports games on Pixuvo are free and open in your browser without signing up or downloading anything.

strategy.intro:
Think first, act second. Strategy games reward kids who like planning, because the smartest move wins rather than the fastest finger. Pixuvo has more than 1,000 strategy games, and many can be played at your own pace.

A big subgroup is tower defense, where you place towers along a path to stop waves of enemies. Castle and war games let you build an army or protect your walls. Others are closer to puzzles, where you need to figure out the right order of moves, and some bigger games have bases and units to manage. Not sure where to begin? Try Empire Tower Defense - Zombie Fortress, King Rugni Tower Defense, Defend the Castle, Castel War 3D, Tower Crush and Babel Tower.

If you have not played strategy games before, tower defense is the friendliest place to start, because the rules are clear and every level teaches one new idea. After that, try a castle game where you also manage resources. Most strategy games are played with a mouse, which makes a computer the most comfortable choice, though many also work on tablets. The game page shows whether a game supports touch screens.

faq.q: What are strategy games?
faq.a: Strategy games are games where planning matters most. You decide what to build, where to put your units or which move to make, and good decisions win more than quick reactions.

faq.q: Which strategy games are easy for beginners?
faq.a: Tower defense games are a great first step because each level introduces one new idea. Defend the Castle is another good one to start with.

faq.q: Are strategy games good for kids' thinking skills?
faq.a: Many strategy games ask you to plan ahead, manage resources and learn from mistakes, which are useful skills. Like any game, they are best enjoyed in reasonable doses.

faq.q: Do strategy games work on tablets?
faq.a: Many do, especially turn-based and tower defense games, but some bigger games are easier with a mouse. The game page tells you whether it works on phones and tablets.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes, every strategy game on Pixuvo is free and opens in your browser without an account.

tank.intro:
Heavy armor, a rotating turret and a cannon that shakes the screen – tank games let you command one of the toughest machines on the battlefield. Pixuvo offers more than 250 free tank games in the browser.

Tank games come in several shapes. Battle games put you in the driver's seat of a tank, arena games keep the fights small and fast, and strategy and tower defense games are more about planning where to place units than about aiming. Right now Tiger Tank, Tanks Blitz, Steel Skirmish, Micro Tank Battle, Age of Tanks Warriors: TD War, Paper Panzer and Tanks 2D War and Heroes sit near the top of the list.

The key skill in many tank games is controlling two things at once: the tank's body moves one way while the turret aims another. Practice driving in a circle while keeping the cannon on target. Use walls and hills as cover, and remember that your shell flies in an arc in many side-view games, so aim higher for far targets. Most tank games use WASD or the arrow keys to drive and the mouse to aim, and plenty of them work on phones and tablets as well – the game page says so. Tank games are part of the shooting category, and many of them also suit fans of strategy.

faq.q: What are tank games?
faq.a: Tank games put you in charge of armored vehicles that drive, aim and fire cannons. Some are fast battles, others are strategy and tower defense games.

faq.q: How do you aim in tank games?
faq.a: In most top-down tank games you drive with WASD and aim the turret with the mouse. In side-view games, shells fly in an arc, so you aim higher for distant targets.

faq.q: Are there tank strategy games?
faq.a: Yes, some tank games are strategy or tower defense games, where planning and placing units matter more than just shooting. Age of Tanks Warriors: TD War is one to try.

faq.q: Can two players play tank games together?
faq.a: Some tank games have a 2 player mode on one keyboard, and some are online. The game page says which when the publisher provides it.

faq.q: Are tank games free to play?
faq.a: Yes, all tank games on Pixuvo are free in the browser with no sign-up.

tower-defense.intro:
Enemies are marching down the road, and only your towers stand in their way. That is the whole idea of tower defense, a classic strategy style. Pixuvo has more than 280 tower defense games to choose from.

Each game follows the same core loop: enemies come in waves along a path, you place towers or heroes next to it, and every enemy you stop gives you coins for more and better towers. What changes is the setting: castles and kingdoms, tanks, zombies that can be a little spooky, or funny meme characters. King Rugni Tower Defense, Tower Siege, Age of Tanks Warriors: TD War, Zombi Defense and Brainrot Tower Defense are a few games listed near the top, and Hot Barrel Cats, Lilliput War, Limited Defense and Ashen Watch are more to explore. Some tower defense games also add heroes you can move around the map.

Beginner tip: put your first towers where the path bends, because enemies stay in range longer there. Mix tower types – some are fast, others hit hard or slow enemies down – and upgrade before you spread out too thin. Tower defense games are usually played with mouse clicks, so they suit computers best, but many also work fine with taps on a tablet. Whether a game runs on mobile is listed on its page.

faq.q: What is a tower defense game?
faq.a: It is a strategy game where enemies walk along a path in waves and you build towers next to it to stop them. Defeating enemies earns money for more towers and upgrades.

faq.q: Where should I place my towers?
faq.a: Corners and bends are the best spots, because enemies stay in range for longer there. Build a few strong towers early and upgrade them before you spread out.

faq.q: What is a good first tower defense game?
faq.a: King Rugni Tower Defense and Tower Siege are good ones to start with, and Brainrot Tower Defense is another one to try.

faq.q: Can I play tower defense games on a tablet?
faq.a: Many tower defense games only need taps to place towers, so they work on tablets and phones. Each game page shows if touch screens are supported.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. All tower defense games on Pixuvo are free to play in your browser, with no sign-up.

truck.intro:
Big wheels, a heavy load and a road full of bumps – truck games are for kids who like their vehicles large and loud. Pixuvo has more than 700 free truck games that run in the browser.

Driving a truck feels very different from driving a car. It is slower to speed up, harder to stop and wider on every turn, so careful driving matters more than raw speed. Some truck games are about delivering cargo without dropping it; others take you off-road through mud and hills, put you in army vehicles or send big trucks onto stunt tracks. There are farm and city jobs too, and even calm puzzle and memory games with trucks. Right now Offroad Masters Challenge, Army Truck Driving, Truck Simulator Stunt Extreme, 3D city tractor garbage sim and Draw Truck Endless sit near the top of the list.

A tip for every truck driver: brake early. Heavy vehicles need more space to stop, and on hills it is easy to roll back or tip over if you rush. Take wide turns and go slowly over bumps when you carry cargo. Most truck games use the arrow keys or WASD, and the game page lists any extra keys. Plenty of them work on phones and tablets as well – the game page says so. Truck games are part of the driving category, next to bus and parking games.

faq.q: What are truck games?
faq.a: Truck games let you drive big vehicles such as trucks, army trucks and tractors. Many are about delivering cargo, climbing off-road hills or doing stunts.

faq.q: How do you drive well in truck games?
faq.a: Brake early, take wide turns and slow down on bumps, especially when carrying cargo. Trucks are heavy, so they need more space than cars.

faq.q: What is an off-road truck game?
faq.a: It is a truck game set on dirt roads, mud and hills instead of smooth streets. Offroad Masters Challenge is one to try.

faq.q: Are there truck games for younger kids?
faq.a: Yes, some truck games are simple puzzles or memory games without fast driving – Army Trucks Memory is one to try. Driving games with short levels are a good next step.

faq.q: Can I play truck games on a tablet?
faq.a: Many truck games have touch controls and run on phones and tablets. You can see on the game page whether a phone or tablet will work.

tycoon.intro:
Start with one burger stand and end with a whole restaurant chain. Tycoon games are about growing something from almost nothing, and the fun is watching numbers, shops and buildings get bigger. Pixuvo has more than 340 tycoon games.

The basic loop is simple: earn money, spend it on upgrades, earn even more. What you manage changes from game to game: a restaurant, a shipyard, a tech company, a police station or even a fantasy world. To get going, try Burger Restaurant Simulator 3D, Shipbuilding Tycoon, Silicon Valley - Idle Tycoon, My Mini Police and Dinosaur World. Many tycoon games are also "idle", which means your business keeps earning while you take a break.

Tycoon games are a gentle way to learn how saving and spending works: buying the cheapest upgrade right away is not always the best choice. A good tip is to upgrade whatever earns the most first. They work well with a mouse, and many lighter ones run on tablets and phones too – check the game page to see if it runs on your device.

faq.q: What is a tycoon game?
faq.a: A tycoon game lets you run and grow a business, like a restaurant, a shipyard or a theme park. You earn money, buy upgrades and expand step by step.

faq.q: What is the difference between tycoon and idle games?
faq.a: Tycoon games are about managing a business, while idle games keep earning even when you stop clicking. Many games are both, like Silicon Valley - Idle Tycoon.

faq.q: Which tycoon game should I try first?
faq.a: A restaurant tycoon is easy to understand, because everyone knows how a restaurant works. Burger Restaurant Simulator 3D and Dinosaur World are two to try.

faq.q: Do tycoon games teach anything about money?
faq.a: In a playful way, yes: you learn that saving up for a better upgrade can pay off more than spending right away. The numbers are pretend, of course.

faq.q: Are these games free to play?
faq.a: Yes. All tycoon games on Pixuvo are free to play, with no account and no download.

word.intro:
Letters scattered on the screen, and somewhere in them a hidden word. Word games are puzzles for anyone who likes reading, spelling or just figuring things out, and Pixuvo has more than 340 of them.

There is a word game for almost every kind of player. Word search and fill-in games ask you to spot words hidden in a grid, crossword games give you clues and squares to fill, and hangman is the classic guessing game. Anagram and letter-building games have you make words from a set of letters, picture-matching games help younger kids link words with pictures, and typing games train speed. Right now Fillwords: Find All the Words, Crossword Quest 3D, Wordquest Hangman, Rise of Words, Lexora, Match Pictures to Words 3D and Speed Typer sit near the top of the list.

Word games are a sneaky way to grow your vocabulary, because every new word you find sticks a little better. If you are new, start with a picture or word-search game, then move to anagrams and crosswords when you want a bigger challenge. Typing games are easiest with a real keyboard, while most other word games work with taps and swipes on tablets and phones – whether a game runs on mobile is listed on its page.

faq.q: What are good word games for kids?
faq.a: Younger kids can start with picture-matching games, word searches are good spelling practice, and hangman is a fun guessing game for any age. A quick way in: Match Pictures to Words 3D, Fillwords: Find All the Words and Wordquest Hangman.

faq.q: Can word games help with spelling and vocabulary?
faq.a: Yes, finding and building words again and again helps you remember how they are spelled and what they mean. They are a fun extra, not a replacement for school practice.

faq.q: How do you play hangman?
faq.a: You guess a hidden word one letter at a time. Each wrong guess adds a part to the picture, and you try to find the word before the picture is finished.

faq.q: Are the word games in English?
faq.a: It depends on the game. Many use English words, and some let you pick another language in the game menu – the game description usually tells you.

faq.q: Is there a typing game to practice speed?
faq.a: Yes – Speed Typer is one to try. Typing games work best with a real keyboard.

zombie.intro:
They are slow, they are clumsy, and there are a lot of them. Zombie games are about surviving the undead horde, and the best ones mix shooting with planning, building and a good dose of humor. Pixuvo has more than 800 free zombie games for the browser.

The zombie world has more variety than you might think. Survival games are about holding out as long as you can, often wave after wave. Some games play with the idea that zombies are clumsy, while others lean more toward action shooting. Not sure where to begin? Try Quarantine Zombies, Zombie Can't Jump, Zombie Hunter Survival, Guns'n'Glory Zombies, Zombie World and Zombie Killer.

The best survival tip: never let yourself get surrounded. Keep moving, use corners and doorways so zombies come from one direction, and upgrade your weapons or defenses between waves when the game allows it. Most zombie games use WASD to move and the mouse to aim, or simple taps on touch screens. Plenty of them work on phones and tablets as well – the game page says so. Zombie games can be spooky or gory, so they are usually better for older kids; games with violent wording are held for manual review, and our parents page explains how. Zombie games are part of the shooting category.

faq.q: What are zombie games?
faq.a: Zombie games are about surviving against crowds of undead creatures. Most mix shooting with strategy, like upgrading weapons or building defenses.

faq.q: How do you survive longer in zombie games?
faq.a: Keep moving, avoid getting surrounded and use doorways or corners so zombies come from one side. Spend coins on upgrades between waves.

faq.q: Are zombie games too scary for kids?
faq.a: Some are cartoony and funny, while others are spooky or gory, so they suit older kids best. Our parents page explains how games are reviewed.

faq.q: What zombie game should I try first?
faq.a: To get going, try Quarantine Zombies and Zombie Hunter Survival. Pick a game with short waves first, so you can learn the controls.

faq.q: Can I play zombie games on my phone?
faq.a: Many zombie games have touch controls and work on phones and tablets. Whether a game runs on mobile is listed on its page.

2-player-racing.intro:
Racing is more fun when the car next to you is driven by your brother, sister or best friend. This page collects more than 200 racing games made for two players, so you can settle who is faster without waiting for anyone online.

Most of these games are played on one keyboard: one player steers with W, A, S and D, the other with the arrow keys. Some use a split screen, so each driver gets half of the monitor, while others put both cars on the same track. A few are online duels instead – the game page tells you which type it is when the publisher provides that information. You'll find classic circuit races, stunt games with huge ramps, off-road challenges, drift battles and even car football where the cars push a giant ball.

Good first picks are Offroad Masters Challenge, Mega Ramp Stunt Racing 3D, Noob vs Pro : Drift Tag and Rocketcar Cup. Tip: sit so both players can reach the keyboard comfortably, and agree on the controls before the countdown starts. Many games also work on tablets – check the game page.

faq.q: How do two players race on one computer?
faq.a: Most 2 player racing games split the keyboard: one driver uses W, A, S, D and the other uses the arrow keys. Some games show a split screen, others put both cars on one shared track.

faq.q: Are there online 2 player racing games too?
faq.a: Yes, a few games let you race someone online instead of on the same keyboard. The game page says which mode a game uses when the publisher shares that detail.

faq.q: What kinds of 2 player racing games are there?
faq.a: You'll find track races, stunt and ramp games, off-road driving, drift battles and car soccer games where you score goals with cars.

faq.q: Can I play 2 player racing games on a phone?
faq.a: Some of them work on phones and tablets, but sharing one keyboard is usually easiest on a computer. Each game page shows which devices it supports.

faq.q: Do I need to download anything?
faq.a: No. Every game runs in your web browser, with no download, no install and no sign-up.

2-player-sports.intro:
Friendly rivalry is what sports are all about, and these more than 250 games let you take it to the screen. Grab a friend, share the keyboard and play a match where the score really matters – because the other player is sitting right next to you.

A big group is football (soccer): penalty duels, headball and short matches with goals at both ends. There's also volleyball, basketball, pool and billiards, and fun mixes such as car soccer where vehicles push the ball. On many games one player uses W, A, S and D and the other uses the arrow keys; a few are online matches against other players. The game page tells you which kind it is when the publisher includes that information.

Want a quick start? Try VOLLEY CLASH, Basketball League, 8 Ball Pool 2D and Toy Soccer Cup. Turn-based sports like pool are great for younger kids who are still learning the keys, because nobody has to react in a split second. Matches are usually short, so you can play "best of three" and swap who picks the next game.

faq.q: What sports can two players play here?
faq.a: Football (soccer), volleyball, basketball, pool and billiards, and car soccer games. The list grows as new games are added.

faq.q: How do I play a sports game against my friend on one keyboard?
faq.a: In most 2 player sports games one player uses W, A, S, D and the other uses the arrow keys. The controls are usually shown before the match starts.

faq.q: Which 2 player sports games are best for younger kids?
faq.a: Turn-based games like 8 Ball Pool 2D are a good start because there is no rush. Simple football and volleyball duels with one or two keys are also easy to learn.

faq.q: Can I play against someone online?
faq.a: Some sports games have online matches. The game page shows the mode when the publisher provides it.

faq.q: Are these sports games free?
faq.a: Yes, they are free to play in your browser with no account and no download.

2-player-shooting.intro:
Two players, one keyboard and a score to beat – that's the idea behind this collection of more than 150 shooting games for two. Some are head-to-head duels where you try to outplay each other, others are co-op games where you team up against waves of enemies.

You'll find platform duels where players knock each other off the map, tank battles, car battles and zombie defense games. In most of them one player moves with W, A, S, D and the other uses the arrow keys, with an extra key or two for firing. A few are online games instead of same-keyboard ones; the game page says which when the publisher provides it.

Games listed near the top include Gun Mayhem Original, Car Battle, Tanks of War Halloween, Zombie swarm and BlockCraft Together. If you're new, start with a co-op game so both players learn the controls together before switching to duels. Parents who want to check what is on Pixuvo can read the page for parents, which explains how games with violent wording are reviewed.

faq.q: What are good 2 player shooting games to play with a friend?
faq.a: Gun Mayhem Original, Car Battle, Tanks of War Halloween and Zombie swarm are easy places to start. The game page shows whether a game is a duel or co-op when the publisher provides it.

faq.q: Are there co-op shooting games, not just duels?
faq.a: Yes. Some games let both players fight on the same side against computer enemies, which is a nice way to learn the controls together.

faq.q: What are the controls for 2 player shooting games?
faq.a: Usually one player uses W, A, S, D plus a fire key and the other uses the arrow keys plus another fire key. Each game shows its own controls at the start.

faq.q: Are these shooting games OK for kids?
faq.a: Many are cartoon-style, but every game is different. Games with violent wording are held for manual review, and parents can read more on the page for parents.

2-player-football.intro:
Kick-off with a friend sitting right beside you! This page gathers more than 80 football (soccer) games for two players, from penalty shootouts to fast one-on-one matches with big heads and bouncy balls.

There are a few main styles. Headball games give each player one character who jumps and kicks next to the goal. Car soccer games swap players for cars that bump a giant ball. Table-style games, like air hockey or flick soccer, let you aim and shoot in turns. Most are played on one keyboard, with one player on W, A, S, D and the other on the arrow keys, and some are online matches. The game page says which mode a game uses when the publisher shares it.

Head Ball Challenge, Soccer Duel, Rocketcar Cup and Coin Flick Soccer are good ones to start with, and Rumble Stars Football - Online Soccer Game is one to check if you want to play online. Matches are short, so play first to three goals and swap sides. Headball is easy to learn – usually just moving, jumping and kicking – which makes it a great first pick for younger kids.

faq.q: What is headball?
faq.a: Headball is a style of football game where each player controls one big-headed character next to their goal. You move, jump and kick to get the ball past the other player.

faq.q: How do two people play football on one keyboard?
faq.a: One player usually uses W, A, S, D and the other uses the arrow keys, with one extra key each for kicking. The controls appear before the match starts.

faq.q: Can I play soccer online against other players?
faq.a: Yes, some games, like Rumble Stars Football - Online Soccer Game, have online matches. Most others are played side by side on one computer.

faq.q: Which 2 player football game is easiest for little kids?
faq.a: Turn-based flick games are the easiest because nobody has to be fast – Coin Flick Soccer is one to try. Headball games are also simple, with only a few keys.

faq.q: Is football the same as soccer here?
faq.a: Yes. These are soccer games – the sport called football in most of the world.

2-player-fighting.intro:
Who is the champion of your house? Settle it here with more than 90 fighting games built for two players on one computer. Every match is short, fast and easy to restart, so the loser can always ask for a rematch.

These games come in a few flavors. Stickman fights use simple stick figures that flip, punch and kick across the screen. Arena brawlers try to push the other player out of the ring or off a platform. Reaction games like the red hands game test who is quicker, and some games are boxing or wrestling-style duels. Usually one player uses W, A, S, D and the other the arrow keys; a few games also support online play, which the game page shows when the publisher provides it.

For a first round, try Stickman: Fighter 3D, Stickman Dragon Fighting, Two Player Red Hands Game, Boxing Gang Stars and Neon Slimes. Before you start, agree how many rounds you'll play. Many fights here are cartoon-style, and games with violent wording are reviewed by hand before they appear on Pixuvo.

faq.q: What are the best 2 player fighting games for kids?
faq.a: Cartoon-style games are a great start – try Neon Slimes, Two Player Red Hands Game or Boxing Gang Stars. Stickman fighting games are another easy choice, because the characters are simple stick figures.

faq.q: Can two players fight on the same keyboard?
faq.a: Yes, that's how most of these games work: one player uses W, A, S, D and the other the arrow keys, each with a few attack keys.

faq.q: What is the red hands game?
faq.a: It's a reflex game for two: one player tries to slap the other's hands, and the other tries to pull them away in time. It's quick and funny, and the game page shows the controls.

faq.q: Are there stickman fighting games for two players?
faq.a: Yes, for example Stickman: Fighter 3D and Stickman Dragon Fighting. You'll find more on the stickman games page.

multiplayer-shooting.intro:
Some shooting games are better with real people on the other side. This page lists more than 250 multiplayer shooting games where you play with or against other players, either online or on the same computer.

The main types are .io arena games, where many players share one big map and try to grow or survive the longest; team battles with tanks, helicopters or cars; pixel-style blocky shooters; and hide-and-seek games where one side hides and the other searches. Some games put two to four people on one keyboard, while others connect you with players online – the game page says which when the publisher provides it.

Good places to start are Tanknarok, Paint or Seek: Chameleon Hide Online, Guardz IO and Helicopter And Tank Battle vehicle wars. In online games you meet players you don't know, so use a nickname, never share personal details and stop playing if someone is unkind. Parents can read more on the Pixuvo page for parents, including how games with violent wording are reviewed.

faq.q: What does multiplayer mean in these games?
faq.a: It means you play with other people, not just the computer. Some games are online with players from anywhere, others let friends play on the same computer.

faq.q: What are .io shooting games?
faq.a: .io games put lots of players in one shared arena. You usually start small, collect points and try to stay in the game as long as possible.

faq.q: Can I play multiplayer shooting games with a friend in the same room?
faq.a: Yes, some games let two or more people play on one keyboard. Check the game page to see if a game is local or online.

faq.q: How can kids stay safe in online multiplayer games?
faq.a: Use a made-up nickname, never share your real name, school or address, and tell a parent if someone is mean. The page for parents explains more.

faq.q: Do I need an account to play online?
faq.a: Not on Pixuvo – you just open the game and play in your browser. Some games may ask you to type a nickname.

kids.intro:
Little hands, big curiosity: this corner of Pixuvo is for younger children and families who want calm, colorful games that teach a little and entertain a lot. It holds more than 3,500 games picked from the educational, coloring and family sections.

Learning games help children practice first words, numbers, shapes and simple math. Coloring and drawing games include coloring pages, paint-by-number and diamond painting, which are relaxing and don't need reading. Pretend-play games let kids be a dentist, a doctor or a painter for a few minutes. Most use just a mouse click or a tap, which makes them easy for children who are new to computers.

For first steps, try My First 100 Words, Master of Numbers, Butterfly Coloring Pages Kids, Diamond Painting by Number and Doctor Teeth. Parents: games are free with no sign-up, and there's a page for parents explaining how Pixuvo reviews games. Some games include ads from the game's publisher, so younger children may need help now and then. Many games also work on tablets – the game page shows it.

faq.q: What are good online games for young kids?
faq.a: Learning and coloring games are a gentle start – you could begin with My First 100 Words, Master of Numbers and Butterfly Coloring Pages Kids. Look for games with simple clicks or taps and no time pressure.

faq.q: What are the best memory games for kids?
faq.a: Card-matching games are the classic choice: you flip two cards and try to find pairs. Try Memory Cards or Flag Memory Match, and see the brain games page for more.

faq.q: Are video games good for kids?
faq.a: In small doses, games that involve counting, words, colors or problem-solving can be a fun way to practice skills. Short sessions and playing together work best.

faq.q: Can my child play on a tablet?
faq.a: Many kids games work on tablets and phones because they only need taps. Each game page shows which devices are supported.

faq.q: Do kids need an account to play?
faq.a: No. There's no sign-up and no download – games open right in the browser.

girls.intro:
Fashion shows, pizza ovens and dream weddings – these are the games many girls love, gathered in one place. Of course, every game here is for everyone, so anyone who likes styling, cooking or caring for others is welcome. There are more than 3,700 games in this collection.

Dress-up games let you mix outfits, hairstyles and accessories, from K-pop looks to anime styles and wedding dresses. Makeover and nail salon games are about colors, patterns and careful little details. Cooking games put you behind the counter of a burger stand or a pizza place, where you follow recipes and serve customers. You'll also find care games, where you look after pets or help characters out.

To start, Aidol K-pop Adventure, Anime Girl Fashion Make Up, Pizza Maker food Cooking Games, Burger Restaurant Simulator 3D and Funny Kitty Care are good ones to try. Most of these games are played with the mouse or by tapping, so they're relaxed and easy. If you like one kind of game best, open the dress-up, cooking or princess pages for even more.

faq.q: What are the best games for girls?
faq.a: Dress-up, makeover and cooking games are a good place to start – Aidol K-pop Adventure and Pizza Maker food Cooking Games are listed near the top. But every game on Pixuvo is for everyone, so try anything that looks fun.

faq.q: What are fun games for girls when you're bored?
faq.a: Quick dress-up and nail salon games, cooking games and pet care games are great when you have a few minutes. Most only need clicks or taps.

faq.q: Are there fashion games for girls who love fashion?
faq.a: Yes, lots. Fashion dress-up games let you design outfits, choose accessories and create whole looks – see Anime Girl Fashion Make Up or the princess games page.

faq.q: Can I play these games on a phone or tablet?
faq.a: Many of them work on phones and tablets because they use simple taps. The game page shows which devices each game supports.

boys.intro:
Speed, battles and big challenges – that's what you'll find in these more than 10,000 racing, fighting and shooting games. Many boys love them, but every game here is for everyone, so anyone who likes action is welcome.

Racing games range from motorbike stunt tracks to car chases and truck driving. Fighting games include stickman battles, arena brawls and one-on-one duels. Shooting games cover zombie survival, tank and convoy battles, and missions where you aim carefully and complete objectives. Some are quick arcade games you can finish in a minute, others have levels you unlock one by one.

To get started, try Moto X3M: Spooky Land for stunt bike racing, or Sumo Shove, Knockback Knights, Stickman Warriors, Quarantine Zombies and Trap the Convoy, which are all listed near the top. Most of these games use the keyboard (arrows or W, A, S, D) and sometimes the mouse for aiming. Want to play with a friend? Check the 2 player racing, 2 player fighting and 2 player shooting pages. Parents can read how Pixuvo reviews games with violent wording on the page for parents.

faq.q: What are good games for boys to start with?
faq.a: Moto X3M: Spooky Land, Stickman Warriors and Quarantine Zombies are listed near the top. But every game on Pixuvo is for everyone, so try anything that looks fun.

faq.q: Are there games for boys that two people can play?
faq.a: Yes. The 2 player racing, fighting and shooting pages have games where two players share one keyboard.

faq.q: Are these action games suitable for kids?
faq.a: Many are cartoon-style action, but every game is different. Games with violent, adult or gambling wording are held for manual review, and parents can find more details on the page for parents.

faq.q: Do I need a keyboard to play?
faq.a: Many action games are easiest with a keyboard, but some also work on phones and tablets with touch controls. The game page shows it.

faq.q: Can girls play games for boys too?
faq.a: Of course. Every game on Pixuvo is for everyone – this page simply groups racing, fighting and shooting games.

brain.intro:
Ready to give your brain a workout? These more than 4,500 games are all about thinking: remembering, counting, finding words and solving puzzles. They're a good choice when you want to play something that also feels a little bit like practice.

Memory games ask you to remember cards, pictures or where a ball is hidden. Math games turn adding, subtracting and multiplying into races and battles. Quiz games test what you know about flags, shapes or emojis, and word games have you build words, solve crosswords or guess letters. On top of that come logic puzzles, where you figure out how to fix, connect or move things in the right order.

Some good starting points listed near the top are Kobadoo Numbers, Kobadoo Arithmetic, Kobadoo Flags, Memory Cards, Flag Memory Match, Three Cups Game and Math Fight Club. Try a few different types to find out which kind of thinking you enjoy most.
