Most brain games need no fast reflexes, just a mouse or a tap, so they work well for younger players and grown-ups who want to play together.

faq.q: Are brain games good for your brain?
faq.a: Brain games are a fun way to practice memory, counting, words and logic. Like any game, they work best in short sessions alongside other activities.

faq.q: What are the best memory games for kids?
faq.a: Card-matching games are the classic choice for kids. Memory Cards, Flag Memory Match and Three Cups Game are three to try.

faq.q: Are there math games for kids?
faq.a: Yes. The math section has more than 700 of them, including Kobadoo Numbers, Kobadoo Arithmetic and Math Fight Club.

faq.q: What kinds of brain games are there?
faq.a: You'll find memory games, math games, quizzes, word games and logic puzzles. Each type trains a slightly different skill.

faq.q: Can I play brain games on a tablet?
faq.a: Many brain games use simple taps, so they often work on tablets and phones. The game page shows which devices are supported.

stickman.intro:
A circle for a head, a few lines for arms and legs – and somehow stickman characters can fight, run, jump, sneak and solve puzzles. This page collects more than 650 stickman games in every style you can imagine.

Stickman fighting games are a big group: quick battles where simple stick figures punch, kick and use special moves. There are also stickman shooting and archery games, boss battle games, defense games where you protect your base, and puzzle games where a stickman has to sneak, escape or steal something clever. Some stickman games are made for two or even four players.

To get going, try Stickman Mega Boss Battles!, Stickman Battle 1-4 Players, Stickman Guys Defense, DOP Stickman and Stickman Thief Puzzle. If you'd rather think than fight, look for the puzzle ones. Because the characters are so simple, the games are easy to understand. Most use the keyboard or mouse; some work with touch on phones and tablets, which the game page shows.

faq.q: What are stickman games?
faq.a: They are games where the characters are simple stick figures. Stickman games can be fighting, shooting, puzzle, defense or adventure games.

faq.q: Can more than one person play stickman games?
faq.a: Yes, some can – the game page shows how many players a game supports. Stickman Battle 1-4 Players is one to check.

faq.q: Are there stickman puzzle games, not just fighting?
faq.a: Yes. Some stickman games are about thinking rather than fighting – DOP Stickman and Stickman Thief Puzzle are two to try.

faq.q: Why do kids like stickman games?
faq.a: The simple characters make the games easy to understand, so you can jump straight into the action.

faq.q: Are stickman games free?
faq.a: Yes, all stickman games on Pixuvo are free to play in your browser, with no download.

unblocked.intro:
Many people search for "unblocked games" when they simply want games that open in a normal web page without installing anything. That is exactly how Pixuvo works: all of its more than 45,000 games run in your web browser, with nothing to download, no app to install, no browser extension and no sign-up.

To be clear about what this page is not: Pixuvo is not a tool for getting around school or network filters, and it doesn't try to bypass them. Schools, workplaces and parents decide which websites are allowed on their computers and networks, and those rules should be respected. If a site is blocked at school, it's best to play at home or during a break when games are allowed. Pixuvo is a regular website, so whether it opens on a given network depends on how that network is set up.

This page lists popular games from across the whole site, based on real plays, so it's a good place to find something quick. Good ones to start with: Drop Planets, Merge Royal, Epic Duck, Kobadoo Numbers, Kobadoo Flags and Three Cups Game. Favorites you mark are saved in this browser on this device.

faq.q: What are unblocked games?
faq.a: People usually mean browser games that run in a normal web page, with no download, install or extension. Pixuvo games work this way, but they don't bypass any filters.

faq.q: Can I use Pixuvo to get around a school filter?
faq.a: No. Pixuvo doesn't bypass school or network filters. Schools and parents decide what is allowed, so please follow their rules.

faq.q: What games can I play without downloading anything?
faq.a: Every game on Pixuvo opens straight in your browser. Drop Planets, Merge Royal and Epic Duck are quick ones to try.

faq.q: Do these games need Flash or a plugin?
faq.a: No. The games run in a modern web browser without Flash, plugins or extensions.

faq.q: Are the games free?
faq.a: Yes, they are free, and you don't need an account. Some games may show ads from their publishers.

animal.intro:
Kittens, sharks, chicks, dogs and even dinosaurs – animals star in more than 2,700 games on this page. Some let you care for pets, some turn animals into heroes, and some are simply silly fun with a furry or feathery main character.

Pet care games are about feeding, washing and looking after animals, which younger kids especially enjoy. Rescue games give you a puzzle to solve to save a trapped cat or another animal in trouble. Arcade games let you play as an animal: flap as a bird, swim as a shark or hop as a little chick. There are also dinosaur adventures and animal jigsaw puzzles.

For gentle play, Save kitten and Funny Rescue Pet are good ones to start with, and Tiny Chick, Shadobirds, Big Shark and Dino Squad Battle Mission are more games listed near the top. Most animal games use simple clicks, taps or arrow keys, so they suit a wide range of ages. Many also work on phones and tablets – the game page shows it.

faq.q: What are good animal games for kids?
faq.a: Gentle rescue and pet care games are a nice start for younger kids – try Save kitten and Funny Rescue Pet. Big Shark and Dino Squad Battle Mission are more good picks.

faq.q: Are there pet care games?
faq.a: Yes, there are games where you feed, wash and look after pets. You'll also find more on the games for girls page, which includes care games like Funny Kitty Care.

faq.q: Are there dinosaur games?
faq.a: Yes, dinosaurs appear in many animal games, from adventures to puzzles – Dino Squad Battle Mission is one to try.

faq.q: Can I play animal games on a tablet?
faq.a: Many animal games use taps or simple clicks, so they often work on tablets. Each game page shows supported devices.

princess.intro:
Crowns, ball gowns and a little bit of magic: this page brings together more than 650 princess games. Here you can be the stylist, the designer and the makeup artist for royal characters – and decide what a princess should look like today.

Most princess games are dress-up games. You choose dresses, hairstyles, shoes and jewelry, and then show off the final look. Makeover games add makeup, face paint or nail designs, and some even let you design tattoos or punk outfits for a princess who isn't so traditional. You'll also find friend-group games where several characters get ready for a party together, and a few adventure games with princess heroines.

Good starting points are Princess Nail Salon, Princess Look Like A Supermodel, Princess Punk Fashion - Tattoo Desgin and Bff Witchy Transformation. Princess games are played mostly with mouse clicks or taps, so there's no rush – take your time with every detail. Like every game on Pixuvo, they're for everyone. Looking for more styling? Try the dress-up category or the games for girls page.

faq.q: What are princess games?
faq.a: They are games about princesses, mostly dress-up and makeover games where you pick outfits, hair, makeup and accessories.

faq.q: What can I do in princess dress-up games?
faq.a: You can choose dresses, shoes, jewelry and hairstyles, try makeup or nail designs, and create a complete look.

faq.q: Are there princess games for younger kids?
faq.a: Yes. Many princess games use simple clicks and have no time limit, so younger kids can play at their own pace.

faq.q: Can I play princess games on a phone?
faq.a: Many dress-up games work well with taps on phones and tablets. The game page shows which devices are supported.

faq.q: Do princess games cost anything?
faq.a: No, they are free to play in your browser, with no download and no sign-up.

space.intro:
Three, two, one, liftoff! More than 650 games on this page take place among stars, planets and alien worlds. Whether you want to defend Earth, build a galaxy or just fly as far as you can, space is a great setting for adventure.

Space shooters are the classic type: you pilot a ship and blast asteroids or alien invaders. Defense games ask you to protect a planet or a farm from aliens, often with a funny twist. Merge and puzzle games let you combine small planets into bigger ones, and arcade games challenge you to dodge, fly and collect stars. Some strategy games let you explore and build in space.

To begin, try Protect the Earth, Dogs vs Aliens, Farmers vs Aliens, Merge Planets Deluxe, Galaxy Pop and Star Rush. If you are new, start with a calm puzzle and move on to faster games once you know the controls. Space shooters usually use the arrow keys or the mouse, while merge games work well with taps. If you love these, the shooting and arcade categories have even more.

faq.q: What are good space games for kids?
faq.a: Calm merge puzzles and quick arcade games are an easy start. Merge Planets Deluxe, Dogs vs Aliens and Star Rush are good examples.

faq.q: Are there space shooter games?
faq.a: Yes, in space shooters you fly a ship and shoot asteroids or alien invaders. Stars Strike and Alien War are two to try.

faq.q: What are planet merge games?
faq.a: In merge games you drop or combine small planets to make bigger ones. Merge Planets Deluxe is one to try.

faq.q: Can I play space games on my phone?
faq.a: Many space games, especially merge and arcade games, work with touch. Each game page shows which devices it supports.

christmas.intro:
Snowflakes, presents and a very busy Santa – Christmas games are a cozy way to get into the holiday mood. This collection has more than 750 winter and Christmas games, and they're here all year round, so you can play even when it's warm outside.

Many Christmas games are about helping Santa: delivering gifts down chimneys, racing his sleigh or protecting the presents. Clicker games let you decorate a Christmas tree or build a giant holiday collection, one click at a time. There are also holiday dress-up games with festive outfits, winter puzzles and match-3 games, and arcade games set in snowy villages.

Chimney Express, Santa Rush Down, Christmas Tree Clicker, Santa Clicker and Christmas Adventures are a few games listed near the top, so they are an easy place to start. Christmas games make a nice family activity during the holidays, because many are short and easy enough for kids and grown-ups to take turns. Most use simple clicks, taps or arrow keys.

faq.q: What are fun Christmas games to play online?
faq.a: Quick Santa games and calm clicker games are both fun picks. You could start with Chimney Express, Santa Rush Down and Christmas Tree Clicker.

faq.q: Are there Christmas games the whole family can play?
faq.a: Yes. Many Christmas games are short and simple, so kids and adults can take turns and compare scores.

faq.q: Can I play Christmas games outside the holiday season?
faq.a: Yes, the Christmas games stay on Pixuvo all year, so you can play them any time.

faq.q: Are there Christmas dress-up games?
faq.a: Yes, there are holiday dress-up games with festive outfits.

faq.q: Are Christmas games free?
faq.a: Yes, they're free to play in your browser with no download or sign-up.

halloween.intro:
Pumpkins, candy, friendly ghosts and cute little monsters – most Halloween games are spooky in a fun way, not a scary one. This page has more than 550 of them, ready to play whenever you feel like a bit of Halloween spirit, not just in October.

You'll find Halloween versions of many favorite game types. Merge games let you combine spooky items into new ones, falling-block and candy-drop puzzles test your timing, and jumping and riding games test your reflexes. Dress-up and nail games let you create costumes and Halloween manicures, and there are a few action games with monster characters too.

Spooky Merge, Halloween Merge Game, Halloween Candy Drop, Falling Blocks - Halloween Challenge, Halloween Hop and Fashion Girl Halloween Boutique are easy places to start. Most Halloween games use clicks, taps or arrow keys, so they're easy for younger kids. If you want something truly spooky, older players can look at the horror category, while many games on this page are about costumes, candy and cartoon monsters.

faq.q: Are Halloween games scary?
faq.a: Many aren't. A lot of the games on this page are about pumpkins, candy, costumes and cartoon monsters, but some can be a little spooky, so check a game first if you are unsure.

faq.q: What are good Halloween games for kids?
faq.a: Spooky Merge, Halloween Candy Drop and Halloween Hop are good ones to start with, and Fashion Girl Halloween Boutique is one to try if you like styling.

faq.q: Are there Halloween dress-up games?
faq.a: Yes, there are Halloween costume and nail games, such as Fashion Girl Halloween Boutique and Crazy Halloween Nail Doctor.

faq.q: Can I play Halloween games all year?
faq.a: Yes, the Halloween games stay on Pixuvo all year round.
